units.name: Aureate Laureate
units.setup: Early fight against 3-Attack enemies; later one Golden-count synergy.
units.basis: 4 printed +3 shield-equivalent -4.5 generic T1 body =2.5/fight; no triple reward and no extra doubling.
units.compare_to: Risen Rider T1: 3 extra combat SP from Reborn; ~1.5 above a 4.5-SP body.
units.premium: A shield plus a free Golden flag, rather than a higher printed body.
units.text: Divine Shield This minion is always Golden, but doesn't give a Triple Reward.

units.name: Bubble Gunner
units.setup: Early Murloc, random keyword averaged at ~2 combat SP; no keyword fishing.
units.basis: 5 body +2 expected keyword -4.5 plain body =2.5/fight; random Venomous has much larger tails.
units.compare_to: Rockpool Hunter historical T1: +1/+1 once, ~1 SP/turn over two turns.
units.premium: One random keyword on a decent body instead of a deterministic small buff.
units.text: Battlecry: Gain a random Bonus Keyword.

units.name: Buzzing Vermin
units.setup: Unbuffed Beetle fits; Taunt directs one death.
units.basis: 2 printed +4 summoned SP -4.5 plain T1 =1.5/fight; Beetle scaling and avenge not included.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: two 1/1s =4 extra combat SP, ~1.5 marginal.
units.premium: Taunt and the Beetle tag change reliability, not raw token SP.
units.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Beetle.

units.name: Cord Puller
units.setup: Shield blocks 3 damage and one Microbot fits.
units.basis: 2 printed +3 shield +2 Microbot -4.5 plain T1 =2.5/fight.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: 4 token SP, ~1.5 marginal.
units.premium: Trades one token for a shield; better with attack buffs.
units.text: Divine Shield Deathrattle: Summon a 1/1 Microbot.

units.name: Crackling Cyclone
units.setup: Early unbuffed fight; shield blocks 3 and Windfury gets one extra 2-Attack swing.
units.basis: 3 printed +3 shield +2 extra swing -4.5 plain T1 =3.5/fight; extra swing is conditional on surviving.
units.compare_to: Aureate Laureate T1: ~2.5 marginal combat SP before Golden synergies.
units.premium: Windfury turns later attack buffs into repeated damage; unusually scalable T1 shell.
units.text: Divine Shield Windfury

units.name: Dark Paradox
units.comps: Any; depends on rolled Dark Gift and tribe synergy
units.setup: Placeholder only: CSV 1/1 and tier 1 are not a fixed live card.
units.basis: Unknown rolled stats, tier and Gift; all zeros mean unvalued, not worthless. Cannot choose a defensible alternative without the roll.
units.compare_to: Aureate Laureate T1: ~2.5 combat-equivalent marginal; only a fixed-card reference, not a valid roll comparison.
units.premium: All-tribe tag is flexible; actual tier premium depends entirely on the roll.
units.text: This has a different Dark Gift, stats, and Tier each game!

units.name: Dune Dweller
units.comps: Elemental shop-buff; Demon consume with Elementals
units.setup: Two Elementals bought and retained/consumed each turn; two-turn early horizon.
units.basis: +1/+1 x2 realised Elementals =4 permanent SP/turn; alternative Lullabot gives 1/turn, so marginal 3. No credit for unsold shop stock.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 1 permanent SP/turn in the same early scaling slot.
units.premium: Upgrades all future Elemental acquisitions and stacks after the card is sold.
units.text: Battlecry: Give Elementals in the Tavern +1/+1 this game.

units.name: Fleeing Fugitive
units.setup: Three spells target this each turn; spells would already be cast.
units.basis: 3 spells x1 Health =3/turn -Lullabot's 1/turn =2 marginal; 5 Attack is immediate tempo, not repeat growth.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 1 permanent Health/turn without spell targeting.
units.premium: Converts spell volume to Health and starts with 5 Attack.
units.text: Whenever you cast a spell on this, gain +1 Health.

units.name: Flighty Scout
units.setup: Held in hand on a six-unit early board; one open slot at Start of Combat.
units.basis: Summoned 3/3 =6 combat SP, equal to playing a 3/3 alternative in the open slot: marginal ~0. Reserve/hand buffs supply the upside; full board without space gives 0.
units.compare_to: Sellemental historical T1: 3/3 played body =6 combat SP, no reserve flexibility.
units.premium: Enables hand investment, but merely hiding a normal body in hand does not create another board slot.
units.text: Start of Combat: If this minion is in your hand, summon a copy of it.

units.name: Flittering Bat
units.setup: One attack, one open slot, unbuffed token.
units.basis: 1 Rally x(1+1) =2 summoned SP; 5 body +2 -4.5 generic T1 =2.5/fight.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: 4 extra token SP, ~1.5 marginal.
units.premium: Healthier source body but summons need both an attack and room.
units.text: Rally: Summon a 1/1 Beast.

units.name: Glim Guardian
units.setup: One attack per fight; no permanent-combat-buff keeper.
units.basis: 1 Rally x2 Attack =2 temporary SP; 5 body +2 -4.5 plain T1 =2.5/fight; retained only with external support.
units.compare_to: Wrath Weaver T1: ~8 permanent SP/turn at two Demon plays, but needs a resource and hero Health.
units.premium: Free first-swing Attack, not self-contained permanent growth.
units.text: Rally: Gain +2 Attack.

units.name: Harmless Bonehead
units.setup: Both Skeletons fit; no Undead attack aura yet.
units.basis: 2 tokens x(1+1) =4; 2 printed +4 -4.5 plain body =1.5/fight. Each aura Attack later applies to two extra bodies.
units.compare_to: Risen Rider T1: one 2/1 Reborn =3 extra SP, ~1.5 marginal.
units.premium: More death events and aura recipients, with more board-space risk.
units.text: Deathrattle: Summon two 1/1 Skeletons.

units.name: Joyous
units.setup: Deity awakens reliably; cycle one Joyous rather than a non-buffing Aberration; two-turn horizon.
units.basis: +2/+1 =3 permanent off-board Deity SP; 3/2 turns =1.5 versus a zero-buff cycle. No second count for C'Thun's combat redistribution.
units.compare_to: Razorfen Geomancer T1: 4 permanent SP once from two base Gems, ~2/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Buff lands on the persistent reserve carry, conditional on awakening.
units.text: Battlecry: Give your Deity +2/+1.

units.name: Lullabot
units.setup: Magnetize onto a retained Mech; no attachment-copy engine.
units.basis: +1 Health/turn -ordinary non-scaling attachment's 0 =1 marginal. Magnetic adds the 2/2 body once (=4 SP); standalone play has sp_one_off 0.
units.compare_to: Micro Machine historical T1: +1 Attack/turn, similar 1/turn gross.
units.premium: Moves the body and growth onto a carry without occupying a lasting extra slot.
units.text: Magnetic At the end of your turn, gain +1 Health.

units.name: Mini-Myrmidon
units.setup: One Spellcraft per turn on a useful attacker; no Lava Lurker retention.
units.basis: One Spellcraft gives +2 temporary Attack, so 5 printed +2 buff =7 combat SP. A usual early Risen Rider slot gives 3 printed +3 Reborn =6, so marginal 7-6 =1 combat SP/fight. No permanent growth without a keeper.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 1 permanent SP/turn; Mini's 2 is normally temporary.
units.premium: A free targeted spell trigger each turn, rather than durable scaling.
units.text: Spellcraft: Give a minion +2 Attack until next turn.

units.name: Ominous Seer
units.setup: Buy an eligible Tavern spell before selling; one discount amortized over two turns.
units.basis: One-off 1 gold /2 turns =0.5 gold/turn x3.5 SP/gold =1.75 versus an ordinary zero-rebate cycle; unused discount gives 0.
units.compare_to: Southsea Busker T1: same 1-gold rebate, ~1.75 SP/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Discount is usable immediately when a spell is offered; no raw-stat premium.
units.text: Battlecry: The next Tavern spell you buy costs (1) less.

units.name: Razorfen Geomancer
units.setup: Two base +1/+1 Blood Gems played on retained units; two-turn comparison.
units.basis: 2 Gems x2 SP =4 once /2 turns =2 marginal versus a zero-buff cycle; upgraded Gems multiply this.
units.compare_to: Sun-Bacon Relaxer historical T1: two base Gems on sale =4 once, ~2/turn.
units.premium: Battlecry supplies Gems before selling; still only a finite resource packet.
units.text: Battlecry: Get 2 Blood Gems.

units.name: Risen Rider
units.setup: Unbuffed Reborn copy returns and fits.
units.basis: Reborn 2/1 =3 extra SP; 3 printed +3 -4.5 plain T1 =1.5/fight; no retained buffs on Reborn.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: 4 extra token SP, ~1.5 marginal.
units.premium: Reliable second body and Taunt with less space demand than two Skeletons.
units.text: Taunt Reborn

units.name: Rot Hide Gnoll
units.setup: Five friendly deaths before this attacks; positioned late.
units.basis: 5 deaths x1 Attack =5 temporary SP; 5 printed +5 -Harmless Bonehead's effective 6 =4/fight marginal.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: effective 6 SP unbuffed, ~1.5 above a plain body.
units.premium: Turns other bodies' deaths into a larger attacker, but creates no permanent growth.
units.text: Has +1 Attack for each friendly minion that died this combat.

units.name: Scarlet Survivor
units.setup: Friendly buffs reach 6 Attack early; shield absorbs a 5-Attack hit.
units.basis: Shield =5 combat-equivalent SP; 6 printed +5 -Glim Guardian effective 7 =4, rounded to 3.5 for threshold risk. Buff-source SP excluded.
units.compare_to: Glim Guardian T1: effective ~7 early combat SP, ~2.5 above plain body.
units.premium: Permanent shield unlock on a stronger base; requires three Attack investment.
units.text: Once this reaches 6 Attack, gain Divine Shield.

units.name: Southsea Busker
units.setup: Collect next-turn gold; amortize one buy over two turns.
units.basis: 1 delayed gold /2 turns =0.5/turn x3.5 =1.75 marginal versus an ordinary zero-rebate buy; timing can enable an extra purchase.
units.compare_to: Shell Collector historical T1: 1 Coin once, ~1.75 marginal over two turns.
units.premium: Banked next-turn buying power, with a weak 3/1 body.
units.text: Battlecry: Gain 1 Gold next turn.

units.name: Suspicious Prisonguard
units.setup: Activate once per turn for 1 gold on a retained unit.
units.basis: +3/+3 =6 gross SP/turn; subtract 1 gold x3.5 SP/gold and Lullabot's free 1/turn =1.5 marginal. Activation is not free.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 1 permanent SP/turn, no activation cost.
units.premium: Large targeted early buff, paid for every turn.
units.text: Activate (1): Give another minion +3/+3.

units.name: Tusked Camper
units.setup: One attack using base +1/+1 Gems; ordinary combat reset.
units.basis: 1 Gem x2 SP =2 combat buff; effective 5+2 =7, same as Glim Guardian's 5+2, so marginal ~0. Combat Gems are not permanent.
units.compare_to: Glim Guardian T1: +2 Attack per attack, ~2.5 above a plain body.
units.premium: Gem-size upgrades scale its Rally; unbuffed version has no special budget advantage.
units.text: Rally: This plays a Blood Gem on itself.

units.name: Wrath Weaver
units.comps: Demon cycling; Soul Rewinder health engine
units.setup: Play two Demons/turn; hero can afford damage, or Rewinder protects it.
units.basis: 2 Demon plays x(+2/+2) =8 permanent SP/turn; alternative Soul Rewinder grows by 2 damage events x2 Health =4/turn, so marginal 8-4 =4 in a T3+ Demon scaling slot. On turns 1–2 before Rewinder is available, versus Lullabot 1/turn the margin is 7. Hero Health costs are additional.
units.compare_to: Micro Machine historical T1: +1 Attack each recruit turn, about 1 permanent SP/turn; Soul Rewinder T2 ~4 Health/turn in this exact two-event setup.
units.premium: High trigger throughput and +4 SP per trigger at Tier 1; hero Health is the limiting resource.
units.text: After you play a Demon, deal 1 damage to your hero and gain +2/+2.

units.name: Zoatroid
units.setup: Sell parent and then spare Tentacle; average rebate over two turns.
units.basis: Extra 0/2 card can sell for 1 gold: 1/2 x3.5 =1.75 versus ordinary sale. If fielded instead, token is 2 body SP plus a death, not another gold credit.
units.compare_to: Sellemental historical T1: extra token also supplies a 1-gold liquidation rebate.
units.premium: Taunt Aberration token can advance Deity instead of being liquidated.
units.text: When you sell this, get a 0/2 Tentacle with Taunt.

units.name: Bilgewater Breakout
units.setup: First box gives a random Golden after about five turns; 70% realisation; valued as 4 gold-equivalent delivered over a five-turn investment.
units.basis: 4 reward-equivalent gold x0.7/5 =0.56, rounded 0.5 gold/turn x3.5 =1.75 versus no-box Pirate. This is not 3 gold every turn; acceleration value is separate and highly state dependent.
units.compare_to: Southsea Busker T1: guaranteed 1 delayed gold, ~1.75 marginal over two turns.
units.premium: Access to a Golden payoff and acceleration, bought with a long delay and random outcome.
units.text: Battlecry: Get a Lockbox. If you already have one, it opens 1 turn sooner instead.

units.name: Blue Volumizer
units.setup: Two Volumizer instances benefit now, including this 1/3 Magnetic; one future instance is retained per turn; assume attached instances retain family eligibility.
units.basis: 2 instances x3 Health +4 attachment SP =10 once; future +3 SP/turn. Red Volumizer has identical 10-once/3-per-turn SP, so pure-SP marginal 0. Choose Health for an Attack-heavy carry; no invented conversion premium for stat balance.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 4 attachment SP once plus 1 Health/turn; Blue's ongoing upgrade ~3/turn at one later purchase.
units.premium: A persistent family counter that also improves earlier investments; no recursive self-retrigger assumed.
units.text: Magnetic. The first time this is played or Magnetized, your Volumizers have +3 Health this game (wherever they are).

units.name: Brain Rotter
units.setup: Discard one otherwise unused generated spell/turn, opportunity value ~0.5 gold; Deity awakens reliably.
units.basis: +2/+2 =4 persistent Deity SP/turn; subtract spare-card opportunity cost 0.5 gold x3.5 =1.75, leaving 2.25. Alternative Joyous buff is 3 once/2 turns =1.5, so marginal 2.25-1.5 =0.75. Existing discard-trigger payoffs are not counted here.
units.compare_to: Joyous T1: +3 Deity SP once, ~1.5/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Repeatable discard outlet; strength chiefly comes from triggering other Aberrations.
units.text: Activate (0): Discard a card to give your Deity +2/+2.

units.name: Bronze Warden
units.setup: Two shields each block 4 damage and Reborn returns 2/1.
units.basis: 2 shields x4 +3 Reborn body =11 added combat SP; 3 printed +11 -Risen Rider effective 6 =8/fight. Shields may be wasted into pings.
units.compare_to: Risen Rider T1: effective 6 SP from two 2/1 bodies, no shields.
units.premium: Reborn refreshes the shield; two protected bodies for a Tier 2 slot.
units.text: Divine Shield Reborn

units.name: Clever Castaway
units.setup: Once/turn discover a spell averaging 2.5 gold of chosen utility; pay 2 gold.
units.basis: 2.5 chosen-spell value -2 activation =0.5 net gold/turn; versus Ominous Seer cycle's 0.5 gold/turn gives marginal (0.5-0.5)x3.5 =0. Choice and repeatability, not assured raw profit.
units.compare_to: Ominous Seer T1: one 1-gold discount, ~0.5 gold/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Repeatable spell selection but most value pays back the activation fee.
units.text: Activate (2): Discover a Tavern spell.

units.name: Crater Miner
units.setup: Choose Gem Day, +1 Attack or Health per Gem; four Gems played permanently per turn.
units.basis: 4 Gems x1 extra SP =4/turn; alternative Razorfen Geomancer's 4 once/2 turns =2/turn, so marginal 2. Immediate-Gem mode is 4 once instead, not additive.
units.compare_to: Razorfen Geomancer T1: two base Gems =4 once, ~2/turn.
units.premium: Can upgrade all later Gems instead of supplying just two; scales with throughput.
units.text: Choose One - Get 2 Blood Gems; or Get a Gem Day.

units.name: Decoy Conjurer
units.setup: Activate once for a useful highest-Attack shop minion; no refreshed-shop search cost charged twice.
units.basis: One minion ~3 gold -2 activation =1 net gold/turn; versus Ominous Seer's averaged 0.5 gold/turn: (1-0.5)x3.5 =1.75. Shop buffs can raise utility substantially.
units.compare_to: Ominous Seer T1: ~0.5 gold/turn rebate on a two-turn horizon.
units.premium: Repeatable 1-gold effective discount on a minion, with restricted selection.
units.text: Activate (2): Steal the highest-Attack minion in the Tavern.

units.name: Electric Synthesizer
units.setup: Three other Dragons, one buy held two fights; no combat retention.
units.basis: Three other Dragons x(+1/+1) =6 combat SP/fight. Usual wide-combat-buffer alternative Humming Bird gives ~6 combat Attack, so buff output is equal; source bodies are 7 versus 5, leaving (7+6)-(5+6) =2 combat SP/fight. Battlecry separately gives 6 permanent SP once; it is not amortized into this combat marginal.
units.compare_to: Humming Bird T2: ~6 combat Attack from six Beast bodies; historical Spawn of N'Zoth T2 ~8 combat SP on four survivors.
units.premium: Front-loads a permanent Dragon buff and repeats a combat buff without needing to die.
units.text: Battlecry and Start of Combat: Give your other Dragons +1/+1.

units.name: Eternal Knight
units.setup: Two Knights both die once/fight, then are retained next turn; no additional summon engine.
units.basis: This Knight gains 2 deaths x6 SP =12/turn; two-Knight board gains 24. Replace it with Risen Rider: one Knight gains 1 death x6 =6, so marginal family growth 24-6 =18. Lifetime aura stock not re-added.
units.compare_to: Eternal Knight historical T2 +1/+1 per death: two-copy board ~8/turn versus one-copy 2/turn, ~6 marginal.
units.premium: Supplied +4/+2 text gives 6 SP per death, with both death count and recipient count scaling.
units.text: Has +4/+2 for each friendly Eternal Knight that died this game (wherever this is).

units.name: Expert Aviator
units.setup: Early T3–T4 turn before Tier 3 Forager is available; hand has a different 10/10 Murloc plus an unbuffed 3/3 Flighty Scout; Aviator attacks after space opens.
units.basis: Aviator adds its 8-SP body and one 20-SP hand summon =28 combat SP. Usual alternative before Forager is a 7-SP tempo body and Flighty Scout summoning its own 6-SP copy from hand into an open slot =13, so marginal 28-13 =15/fight. With Forager available and reliable, Aviator may add no extra summon value.
units.compare_to: Flighty Scout T1: summons only itself, 6 SP unbuffed; Aviator can choose an already buffed different Murloc. Diremuck Forager T3 is the more reliable later substitute.
units.premium: Summons a different, heavily hand-buffed carry; needs an attack and board space.
units.text: Rally: Summon the highest- Attack Murloc from your hand for this combat only.

units.name: Fire Baller
units.setup: Sell into six retained units; assume this sale adds +1 Attack per target to each of two subsequent Baller sale effects per turn.
units.basis: Immediate 6 targets x1 Attack =6 permanent SP once; future contribution 2 later sale effects x6 retained targets x1 assumed improvement =12 permanent SP/turn. The other Baller gives the same total in the other stat, so marginal 0 in a pure-SP allocation model. This estimates only the extra family increment caused by this sale, not all future Baller output.
units.compare_to: Snow Baller T2: ~6 SP once and ~12 future SP/turn from this one upgrade at two later sales into six targets; increment size remains assumed.
units.premium: A wide sale buff plus a persistent increase in future sale-buff size; Attack/Health preference decides between equal-SP siblings.
units.text: When you sell this, give your minions +1 Attack. Improve your future Ballers.

units.name: Forest Rover
units.setup: Own Beetle plus one other Beetle summoned each fight; both fit.
units.basis: Own 2/2 Beetle becomes 4/3 =7 SP; other Beetle gains 3 SP =>10 added. 2 printed +10 -Buzzing Vermin effective 6 =6 marginal/fight. Lasting Beetle counter is not recruit-board growth.
units.compare_to: Buzzing Vermin T1: 4 Beetle SP plus 2 body =6 effective combat SP.
units.premium: A permanent token-family upgrade affecting every future Beetle, with an immediate token of its own.
units.text: Battlecry: Your Beetles have +2/+1 this game. Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Beetle.

units.name: Green Volumizer
units.setup: Two family instances benefit now, one later retained instance/turn; attached-family eligibility assumed.
units.basis: Two instances x2 buff SP +6 attachment =10 once; +2 future SP/turn. Red Volumizer gives 10 once+3/turn, so marginal (10-10)/2 +(2-3) =-1 in this pure-SP setup. Balanced allocation can still be preferable; family attachment eligibility is uncertain.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 4 SP attached once and 1 Health/turn.
units.premium: Two stats on every family instance, balanced allocation instead of Red/Blue's three of one stat.
units.text: Magnetic. The first time this is played or Magnetized, your Volumizers have +1/+1 this game (wherever they are).

units.name: Humming Bird
units.setup: Six other Beast bodies attack over the fight, including summons; Bird survives initial setup.
units.basis: 6 Beast bodies x1 Attack =6 combat SP; 5 printed +6 -Buzzing Vermin's effective 6 =5/fight. No credit for Attack on a body that never trades.
units.compare_to: Dire Wolf Alpha historical T1: ~2 combat Attack on two neighbours before deaths; roughly 0–2 marginal.
units.premium: Combat-wide tribal Attack reaches replacement tokens, not just the starting board.
units.text: Start of Combat: For the rest of this combat, your Beasts have +1 Attack.

units.name: Intrepid Botanist
units.setup: Three stat-granting Tavern spells/turn, averaging two retained targets each; choose one extra stat.
units.basis: 3 spells x2 targets x1 extra SP =6 permanent SP/turn; versus Dune Dweller's two Elementals x2 =4 in a mixed shop/spell comp: marginal 2. Non-stat spells assumed not to generate stats by themselves.
units.compare_to: Dune Dweller T1: ~4 permanent SP/turn at two Elemental acquisitions.
units.premium: Upgrades a recurring resource across tribes and can leave the board immediately.
units.text: Choose One - Your Tavern spells give an extra +1 Attack this game; or +1 Health.

units.name: Laboratory Assistant
units.setup: Use all next three refreshes with a Demon alive; each inserted Fodder is assumed worth 6 SP after shop bonuses.
units.basis: 3 automatic consumptions x6 assumed SP =18 permanent SP once; Mind Muck in same shop eats one 8-SP minion, so marginal (18-8)/2 =5 SP/turn. Fodder base stats absent from supplied library; meal size and use of all three refreshes are assumptions.
units.compare_to: Mind Muck T2: ~8 permanent SP once, ~4/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Three automatic meals instead of one selected meal, gated by refreshes rather than purchases.
units.text: Battlecry: Add a Fodder to your next 3 Refreshes.

units.name: Lava Lurker
units.setup: One Deep-Sea Angler +2/+6 Spellcraft per turn, first onto Lurker; donor already present.
units.basis: One retained +2/+6 =8 permanent SP/turn; ordinary Naga would keep 0. Versus Fleeing Fugitive with this one targeted spell, 1 Health/turn, marginal 8-1 =7. No extra count of the donor's temporary buff.
units.compare_to: Fleeing Fugitive T1: 1 Health per targeted spell; ~1/turn with this same one-spell setup.
units.premium: Turns a temporary buff into permanent carry growth, once per turn.
units.text: The first Spellcraft spell played from hand on this each turn is permanent. (1 left!)

units.name: Lurking Lionfish
units.setup: Once/turn left-most Beast kills a 0/1 Fishbait, gains +5/+5; assume no other Rally bonuses.
units.basis: 10 permanent SP -2 gold x3.5 =3 net SP/turn; versus Lullabot's 1 free SP/turn gives marginal 2. A Wolf Pup Rally during this recruit attack is extra, not baked in.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 1 permanent SP/turn; ordinary Beast without Fishbait has no recruit attack.
units.premium: A reliable large carry buff plus an unusual recruit attack that can make combat-style Rally permanent.
units.text: Activate (2): Choose a card in the Tavern. Replace it with a Fishbait for your left-most Beast to attack.

units.name: Mechagnome Interpreter
units.setup: Two played or Magnetized Mechs/turn retained on board; each triggers once, not twice.
units.basis: 2 Mechs x(+3/+1) =8 permanent SP/turn -Lullabot's 1/turn in the engine slot =7 marginal. Base attachment stats belong to purchased cards, not Interpreter.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: +1 Health/turn, excluding its attachment body.
units.premium: Four stats per Mech play, with Magnetic allowing the buff to persist through cycling.
units.text: Whenever you play or Magnetize a Mech, give it +3/+1.

units.name: Mind Muck
units.setup: Choose a retained Demon; consume an 8-SP shop minion; two-turn horizon.
units.basis: One eaten body ~8 permanent SP once; Razorfen's 4 once is the available flexible buff alternative, so (8-4)/2 =2 marginal. Stronger shops raise both meal value and opportunity cost.
units.compare_to: Razorfen Geomancer T1: two base Gems =4 once, ~2/turn.
units.premium: Transfers an entire shop body's stats to a carry; scales with shop upgrades.
units.text: Battlecry: Choose a friendly Demon. It consumes a minion in the Tavern to gain its stats.

units.name: Nerubian Deathswarmer
units.setup: Four current Undead, four extra Undead bodies over combat; one new retained Undead/turn.
units.basis: +1 Attack x4 current =4 durable aura SP once, +1 per later retained acquisition/turn, and +4 on extra combat bodies. Versus Razorfen's 4 once and no aura, marginal 1 future +4x0.625 useful attacking-body realisation =3.5 mixed SP/turn. No second permanent copy of combat tokens.
units.compare_to: Razorfen Geomancer T1: 4 permanent SP once; no future-body aura.
units.premium: This-game Attack applies again to every Reborn and summoned Undead.
units.text: Battlecry: Your Undead have +1 Attack this game (wherever they are).

units.name: Patient Scout
units.setup: Hold three turns, sell for an upgraded discover, value only the card, not a fabricated gold amount per tier.
units.basis: One discovered minion ~3 gold /3 turns =1 gold/turn; versus Decoy Conjurer's 1 net gold/turn gives 0 marginal economy. Higher-tier selection is strategic upside; weak body and delayed reward cost tempo.
units.compare_to: Sellemental historical T1: one 3/3 token worth ~3 gold-equivalent immediately; Scout exchanges tempo for future tier access.
units.premium: Discover can find a future engine earlier; card quantity stays one.
units.text: When you sell this, Discover a Tier 1 minion. (Improves each turn!)

units.name: Prodigious Tusker
units.comps: Quilboar Rally; wide attacks; enlarged Gems
units.setup: Five other friendly attacks while Tusker lives; base +1/+1 Gems.
units.basis: 5 other attacks x2 base-Gem SP =10 in-fight buffs. Tusker has 7 printed SP, versus Roadboar 6 and no Gems played during this fight: marginal (7+10)-6 =11 combat SP/fight. Roadboar's generated Gems are a next-recruit benefit, outside this in-fight comparison.
units.compare_to: Tusked Camper T1: ~2 combat SP at one self-attack; Roadboar T2 has no immediate combat buff, but can generate ~4 permanent SP next recruit.
units.premium: Feeds the whole attack sequence instead of just its own Rally; highly sensitive to survival.
units.text: Whenever another friendly minion attacks, this plays a Blood Gem on it.

units.name: Red Volumizer
units.setup: Two family instances benefit now, one later retained instance/turn; attached-family eligibility assumed.
units.basis: 2 instances x3 Attack +4 Magnetic body =10 once; +3 per later instance/turn. Blue Volumizer supplies the same SP totals, so 0 pure-SP marginal; Attack/Health needs decide the buy.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 4 attachment SP once plus 1 Health/turn; Red ~3/turn after one subsequent family purchase.
units.premium: A shared Attack counter rewards repeated family purchases; larger benefit with several active instances.
units.text: Magnetic. The first time this is played or Magnetized, your Volumizers have +3 Attack this game (wherever they are).

units.name: Roadboar
units.setup: Two attacks per fight; generated Gems survive in hand and are played permanently next recruit; base Gems.
units.basis: 2 Rallies x1 Gem x2 SP =4 permanent SP/turn after one-fight lag; versus Razorfen's two Gems once amortized to 2/turn gives marginal 2. No combat stats credited for unplayed Gems.
units.compare_to: Razorfen Geomancer T1: 4 once, ~2/turn; Tusked Camper T1 ~2 temporary combat SP per attack.
units.premium: Repeatable transferable Gems, rather than a one-off packet or temporary self-buff.
units.text: Rally: Get a Blood Gem.

units.name: Scarlet Skull
units.setup: Both versions die, both +1/+2 Deathrattles find a living Undead.
units.basis: Reborn 2/1 =3 SP plus 2 deaths x3 buff SP =6 =>9 added; 3 body +9 -Risen Rider effective 6 =6/fight. Buffs reset.
units.compare_to: Risen Rider T1: 3 extra Reborn SP, effective 6 total.
units.premium: Each life buffs another Undead; two transfers plus two death events.
units.text: Reborn Deathrattle: Give a friendly Undead +1/+2.

units.name: Sellemental
units.setup: Sell parent; use or sell generated 3/3; one buy amortized over two turns.
units.basis: Extra minion card ~3 gold /2 =1.5 gold-equivalent/turn; versus Shell Collector's 0.5 gives (1.5-0.5)x3.5 =3.5. If immediately liquidated, extra token yields only 1/2 gold/turn instead.
units.compare_to: Sellemental historical T1: same 3/3 token and ~3-gold utility once; the present T2 text itself has no effect premium.
units.premium: Extra Elemental play and retained token value; moving up a tier delays access rather than strengthening text.
units.text: When you sell this, get a 3/3 Elemental.

units.name: Shell Collector
units.setup: One Tavern Coin from one purchase, used later; amortize two turns.
units.basis: 1 Coin /2 =0.5 gold/turn; versus Southsea Busker's same 0.5 yields 0 SP marginal. Bankability and 4/3 versus 3/1 body are upside, not recurring income.
units.compare_to: Southsea Busker T1: 1 next-turn gold once; ~1.75 SP/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Better tempo body and flexible gold timing, no larger rebate.
units.text: Battlecry: Get a Tavern Coin.

units.name: Snow Baller
units.setup: Sell into six retained units; assume this sale adds +1 Health per target to each of two subsequent Baller sale effects per turn.
units.basis: Immediate 6 targets x1 Health =6 permanent SP once; future contribution 2 later sale effects x6 retained targets x1 assumed improvement =12 permanent SP/turn. The other Baller gives the same total in the other stat, so marginal 0 in a pure-SP allocation model. This estimates only the extra family increment caused by this sale, not all future Baller output.
units.compare_to: Fire Baller T2: ~6 SP once and ~12 future SP/turn from this one upgrade at two later sales into six targets; increment size remains assumed.
units.premium: A wide sale buff plus a persistent increase in future sale-buff size; Attack/Health preference decides between equal-SP siblings.
units.text: When you sell this, give your minions +1 Health. Improve your future Ballers.

units.name: Soul Rewinder
units.setup: Four recruit-phase hero-damage events/turn, all rewound; no opponent combat damage rewind assumed.
units.basis: 4 events x2 Health =8 permanent SP/turn -Lullabot's 1 free SP/turn =7 marginal; hero Health saved is additional survival value, not gold. Versus a third Weaver in a two-Demon turn, growth is similar but Rewinder prevents damage.
units.compare_to: Wrath Weaver T1: 8 permanent SP/turn at two Demon plays, while costing hero Health.
units.premium: Removes the health cost of an engine while becoming a large Health carry.
units.text: After your hero takes damage, rewind it and give this +2 Health.

units.name: Surfing Sylvar
units.setup: Two valid neighbours and one friendly Golden minion; repeat once in addition to original cast.
units.basis: 2 neighbours x1 Attack x(1 base +1 Golden repeat) =4 permanent SP/turn; Lullabot alternative gives 1 =>3 marginal.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 1 permanent SP/turn; Aureate Laureate T1 adds one guaranteed repeat but no growth alone.
units.premium: Scales free targeted output with Golden count and adjacency.
units.text: At the end of your turn, give adjacent minions +1 Attack. Repeat for each friendly Golden minion.

units.name: Tad
units.comps: Murloc cycling; hand supply; Battlecry chains
units.setup: Random Murloc is useful as a played card rather than immediately sold; two-turn horizon.
units.basis: One extra minion ~3 gold /2 =1.5 gold-equivalent/turn; versus Shell Collector 0.5 =>(1.5-0.5)x3.5 =3.5. Liquidation-only floor is 0.5 gold/turn; no extra card-stat credit.
units.compare_to: Sellemental historical T1: useful generated 3/3 also ~3 gold-equivalent once.
units.premium: Random tribe card can supply Battlecries, triples or a hand summon; less predictable tempo than a fixed token.
units.text: When you sell this, get a random Murloc.

units.name: Tarecgosa
units.setup: One Recruiter attack buff +3/+1 and Synthesizer +1/+1, plus another +2/+2 combat buff on Tarecgosa per fight.
units.basis: 4+2+4 =10 permanent retained SP/turn; ordinary Dragon retains 0. Versus Lullabot's 1/turn growth, marginal 9; same fight buffs belong to donors and are not re-added here.
units.compare_to: Lava Lurker T2: ~8 permanent SP/turn retaining one +2/+6 Spellcraft; cross-tribe analogue, not same Dragon-slot replacement.
units.premium: Keeps all qualifying combat gains and keywords rather than one Spellcraft per turn.
units.text: This permanently keeps Bonus Keywords and stats gained in combat.

units.name: Thaumaturgist
units.setup: Nine spells previously cast gives assumed +4/+4 Spellcraft; no permanent keeper.
units.basis: Base +1/+1 plus 3 upgrades x(+1/+1) =8 temporary SP/fight; Mini-Myrmidon adds 2 =>6 marginal. With Lurker it becomes retained, attributed to Lurker's payoff rather than counted twice.
units.compare_to: Mini-Myrmidon T1: 2 temporary Attack/turn.
units.premium: Grows a reusable spell with total spell count, a small resource-scaling engine at Tier 2.
units.text: Spellcraft: Give a minion +1/+1 until next turn. (Improved by every 3 spells you've cast this game!)

units.name: Underrot Spawn
units.setup: On death, five useful surviving attackers receive +1 Attack and a 0/2 Taunt fits.
units.basis: 5 Attack +2 Tentacle SP =7 added; 4 body +7 -Harmless Bonehead effective 6 =5; reduce by ~2 for weaker surviving attackers/Deity-slot competition =>3 marginal. No permanent Attack credited.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: 4 extra token SP, effective 6 before Undead aura.
units.premium: Combines a protected death event with a wide Attack buff; can accelerate Deity awakening.
units.text: Deathrattle: Summon an 0/2 Tentacle with Taunt. Give your minions +1 Attack.

units.name: Very Hungry Winterfinner
units.setup: Survives two damage events/fight, hand target is later fielded or summoned; persistent hand buffs assumed from card design.
units.basis: 2 damage events x(+2/+1) =6 persistent hand SP/turn; Lullabot grows a fielded carry by 1 =>5 marginal if hand stats are realised. No automatic on-board growth without a hand outlet.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 1 on-board SP/turn; no deployment requirement.
units.premium: Stores attack and health on a reserve carry while its Taunt body absorbs hits.
units.text: Taunt Whenever this takes damage, give a minion in your hand +2/+1.

units.name: Wandering Willbreaker
units.setup: Sell; choose one of two random spells worth ~2 gold-equivalent; forced discard has no extra payoff in base case.
units.basis: Only one playable spell, ~2 gold utility /2 turns =1 gold/turn; versus Shell Collector 0.5: (1-0.5)x3.5 =1.75. Do not value two cards at 6 gold; discard triggers can add upside.
units.compare_to: Ominous Seer T1: 1-gold discount once, ~0.5 gold/turn.
units.premium: A choice of spell plus a discard event; the discarded alternative is not a second spendable card.
units.text: When you sell this, get 2 random Tavern spells. When you play one, discard the other.

units.name: Abyssal Envoy
units.setup: Once/turn exchange a spare generated card worth 0.5 gold for a random spell worth ~2 gold; no discard payoff counted.
units.basis: 2 output utility -0.5 input utility =1.5 net gold/turn; versus Clever Castaway's 0.5 net gold/turn gives (1.5-0.5)x3.5 =3.5 marginal. Discarding a useful 3-gold minion would instead lose value.
units.compare_to: Wandering Willbreaker T2: one usable spell ~2 gold once, ~1 gold/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Repeatable cheap-card conversion plus discard triggers; not unconditional free cards.
units.text: Activate (0): Discard a card to get a random Tavern spell.

units.name: Accord-o-Tron
units.setup: Magnetized onto a Mech held at least three turns; start-of-turn gold collected.
units.basis: 1 gold/turn x3.5 =3.5 SP-equivalent; versus Lullabot's 1 Health/turn gives 2.5 marginal. Its 3/3 attachment is 6 SP once; first income is next turn.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 4 attachment SP once and 1 permanent Health/turn.
units.premium: An extra gold every turn attached without a lasting separate board slot.
units.text: Magnetic At the start of your turn, gain 1 Gold.

units.name: Amber Guardian
units.setup: One useful Dragon lacks a shield; shield avoids an 8-Attack hit; no permanent keeper.
units.basis: +2/+2 =4 plus shield avoiding an 8-Attack hit =12 added combat SP. Electric Synthesizer gives 3 other Dragons x2 =6 combat SP; source bodies are 5 versus 7, so marginal (12-6)+(5-7) =4 per fight. This compares ongoing combat effects, holding previously retained buffs fixed; Synthesizer's Battlecry packet is a separate one-off.
units.compare_to: Electric Synthesizer T2: 6 once and 6 combat SP on three Dragons.
units.premium: Concentrated shield protection on a carry; can be retained by Tarecgosa, but that synergy is not credited twice.
units.text: Taunt Start of Combat: Give another friendly Dragon +2/+2 and Divine Shield.

units.name: Annoy-o-Module
units.setup: Attach to a large unshielded Mech; shield avoids a 10-Attack hit each fight; two-turn horizon.
units.basis: Shield avoids a 10-Attack hit/fight. At the second fight, compare attachments: Module adds 6 body SP+10 shield SP; usual Lullabot alternative adds 4 body SP+2 accrued Health =6. Marginal (6+10)-(4+2) =10 combat SP in that fight. The permanent attachment difference is not separately amortized into this combat marginal.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 4 SP attached once plus 1 Health/turn.
units.premium: A permanent Divine Shield and Taunt on an already grown carry, without another final board slot.
units.text: Magnetic Divine Shield Taunt

units.name: Auto Accelerator
units.comps: Mech Volumizer; Magnetic supply; Battlecry cycling
units.setup: One random Volumizer is useful as a 3-gold minion card, bought once per two-turn comparison; family buffs valued on the generated card's row.
units.basis: One card ~3 gold /2 turns =1.5 gold-equivalent/turn; versus Decoy Conjurer's 1 net gold/turn =>(1.5-1)x3.5 =1.75. No double credit for its Magnetic stats.
units.compare_to: Tad T2: one useful random Murloc on sale, also ~1.5 gold-equivalent/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Targets the Magnetic family and uses Battlecry retriggers, rather than a sale-only trigger.
units.text: Battlecry: Get a random Magnetic Volumizer.

units.name: Azsharan Cutlassier
units.setup: Three stat-granting Tavern spells/turn, two retained targets per spell; cycle the minion.
units.basis: 3x2x1 extra Attack =6 permanent SP/turn; Intrepid Botanist choosing Attack yields the same 6, so text-only marginal 0. If held, 6/4 rather than 3/4 gives 3 extra body SP, not growth.
units.compare_to: Intrepid Botanist T2: +1 of either stat per spell target, ~6/turn in this setup.
units.premium: More Attack on the source body and a retriggerable Battlecry, not a larger per-target upgrade.
units.text: Battlecry: Your Tavern spells give an extra +1 Attack this game.

units.name: Blue Whelp
units.setup: Two previous Rally triggers have each upgraded spell Health by 1; three stat spells average two retained targets per turn.
units.basis: 2 accrued upgrades x3 spells x2 targets =12 permanent SP/turn; Botanist's one upgrade gives 6, marginal 6 now. Each further Rally adds another ~6/turn run rate; first-round contribution can be only 0–6.
units.compare_to: Intrepid Botanist T2: one +1 stat upgrade, ~6 SP/turn, with no further ramp.
units.premium: Repeatedly raises a persistent spell counter; early attacks improve later turns rather than the present fight.
units.text: Rally: Your Tavern spells give an extra +1 Health this game.

units.name: Cadaver Caretaker
units.setup: Undead aura +2 Attack; all three Skeletons fit and trade; own body also has aura.
units.basis: 3 Skeletons x(3+1) =12 added SP. Own 3/3 plus aura =8; Bonehead with same aura has 4 own +2x4 tokens =12 effective; marginal 8+12-12 =8, discounted to 6 for third-token crowding.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: ~8 token SP with +2 Undead Attack, effective 12 total.
units.premium: One additional aura-scaled death body and a less fragile source; board-space limits can erase the gain.
units.text: Deathrattle: Summon three 1/1 Skeletons.

units.name: Deadly Spore
units.setup: Opponent has an unshielded 10/10 carry; 75% chance to reach and damage a worthwhile target; no repeated poison kills.
units.basis: 0.75 x20 enemy SP removed =15 combat-equivalent SP; 2 printed +15 -Risen Rider effective 6 =11 marginal. Against tokens or shields this estimate collapses.
units.compare_to: Deadly Spore historical T3 Poisonous: first kill similar ~20 enemy SP, potentially additional kills; current Venomous is one damaging kill per fight.
units.premium: Matchup answer whose value follows enemy size rather than a stat-growth budget.
units.text: Venomous

units.name: Deep-Sea Angler
units.setup: One useful +2/+6 spell per turn; no Lurker keeper and no additional Taunt valuation.
units.basis: +2/+6 =8 temporary SP/fight; Thaumaturgist at nine prior spells gives +4/+4 =8, so pure-SP marginal 0. Taunt selection and Health allocation can be decisive.
units.compare_to: Mini-Myrmidon T1: 2 temporary Attack/turn; Thaumaturgist T2 ~8 temporary SP at nine spells.
units.premium: Higher floor, Health and Taunt control rather than requiring accumulated spell count.
units.text: Spellcraft: Give a minion +2/+6 and Taunt until next turn.

units.name: Devout Hellcaller
units.comps: Demon combat damage; multi-attack Demon boards
units.setup: Five damage events from other friendly Demons while this survives; one event per damage-dealing source action, not per point of damage.
units.basis: 5 events x(+2/+2) =20 explicitly permanent SP/turn; Wrath Weaver at two recruit Demon plays gives 8, so marginal 12. Hero damage is not a Demon dealing damage here.
units.compare_to: Wrath Weaver T1: ~8 permanent SP/turn at two Demon plays.
units.premium: Four permanent SP from combat events without buying a Demon for each trigger.
units.text: After another friendly Demon deals damage, gain +2/+2 permanently.

units.name: Diremuck Forager
units.setup: Hand contains a 15/15 Murloc; summon waits for space. Expert Aviator would summon it in only two thirds of fights because it must attack alive.
units.basis: One 15/15 =30 added combat SP; Aviator expected 2/3 x30 =20, so 10 marginal reliability SP. No extra stats granted to the hand by this CSV version.
units.compare_to: Flighty Scout T1: only summons its own unbuffed 3/3 =6 SP; Expert Aviator T2 ~20 expected here.
units.premium: Waiting for space removes the attack/survival gate and converts hand investment into dependable combat power.
units.text: Start of Combat: When you have space, summon the highest-Attack Murloc from your hand for this combat only.

units.name: Disguised Graverobber
units.comps: Undead Battlecry reuse; sell/buy cycling; triples
units.setup: Destroy an unbuffed Deathswarmer after using its Battlecry; replay the plain copy, then sell normally; four current Undead and eight total combat bodies.
units.basis: Returned plain card (~3 gold) replaces destroyed unbuffed card (~3), net card economy 0. Replaying Deathswarmer adds ~4 persistent aura SP once and ~4 extra combat-body Attack; 4/2 +4 minus Razorfen cycle's 4/2 =4 marginal mixed SP/turn. No recruit Deathrattle value is assumed. Buffed targets lose enchantments.
units.compare_to: Nerubian Deathswarmer T2: a fresh +1 Attack this-game aura gives ~4 current-board SP once plus token benefits.
units.premium: Reuses a specific Battlecry or moves a shop-bought unit back to hand; normal copy alone is not a free extra minion.
units.text: Battlecry: Destroy a friendly Undead to get a plain copy of it.

units.name: Drifting Sacrifice
units.setup: Both 2/1 lives die; explicit Deity-targeted Deathrattle assumed to advance persistent reserve stats even in combat; awakening reliable.
units.basis: 2 Deathrattles x(+2/+1) =6 persistent Deity SP/turn; Brain Rotter gives 4 minus 0.5-gold spare-card cost x3.5 =2.25 net, so 6-2.25 =3.75. Reborn adds 3 combat-body SP, not another lasting copy. If Deity buffs reset, reclassify 6 as combat-only.
units.compare_to: Joyous T1: +3 persistent Deity SP once, ~1.5/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Two repeatable sacrifice triggers and two deaths toward awakening, with no hand discard cost.
units.text: Reborn Deathrattle: Give your Deity +2/+1.

units.name: Fearless Foodie
units.setup: Choose permanent +1/+1 Gem upgrade; six Gems played on retained minions per turn.
units.basis: 6 Gems x2 extra SP =12 permanent SP/turn; Crater Miner's Gem Day supplies one extra stat x6 =6, so marginal 6. Alternative 4-Gem mode gives 8 SP once at base Gem size; not additive.
units.compare_to: Crater Miner T2: Gem Day adds ~6 SP/turn at six Gems.
units.premium: Twice the upgrade per future Gem; scales immediately with existing Gem production.
units.text: Choose One - Your Blood Gems give an extra +1/+1 this game; or Get 4 Blood Gems.

units.name: Fetid Corroder
units.comps: Aberration discard; wide boards; Tavern spells
units.setup: Generate Sludge Corrosion and discard it through an already-present outlet; seven retained units; ignore outlet's own payoff.
units.basis: Sludge gives +1/+1 to seven units and casts twice if discarded: 7x2x2 =28 permanent SP once; Razorfen supplies 4 once, so (28-4)/2 =12 marginal. If played normally, only 14; no gold credit added.
units.compare_to: Razorfen Geomancer T1: 4 once; generated Sludge is a much wider resource packet.
units.premium: A generated spell with a discard double-cast clause can exceed ordinary Tier 3 buff output.
units.text: Battlecry: Get a Sludge Corrosion.

units.name: Fruit Vendor
units.setup: Activate for 1 gold, get two +2/+2 Tavern Dish Bananas; both cast on retained minions.
units.basis: 2 Bananas x4 SP =8 gross/turn -1x3.5 =4.5 net; Prisonguard gives 6-3.5 =2.5 net, so marginal 2. Generated cards are not an additional 2 gold of profit.
units.compare_to: Suspicious Prisonguard T1: +3/+3 for 1 gold =6 gross, 2.5 net SP/turn.
units.premium: Two additional stats and two spell triggers, with flexible targeting.
units.text: Activate (1): Get 2 Tavern Dish Bananas.

units.name: Gem Rat
units.setup: Two previously generated Gem Days each added one stat; six other-source Gems played per turn; no Trailblazer.
units.basis: 2 accrued upgrades x6 Gems =12 permanent SP/turn now; a second Roadboar generating two current 4-SP Gems adds 8, so marginal 4. Each new Gem Day raises next turn's run rate by another 6; the first extra-day turn adds only 6.
units.compare_to: Crater Miner T2: one Gem Day once, ~6 SP/turn at six Gems.
units.premium: A growing stock of Gem upgrades instead of a single upgrade; requires Gem production elsewhere.
units.text: At the end of your turn, get a Gem Day.

units.name: Greedy Conniver
units.setup: Normal non-Golden buy for tempo. Golden sale reward is conditional and is not assumed to occur.
units.basis: Printed 7+7 =14; usual early shield alternative Scarlet Survivor at 6/6 threshold has original 6 body plus ~7 shield SP =13 before donor investment; rough margin 1/fight. Tier 7 discover upside unvalued until a Golden route and payout turn are specified.
units.compare_to: Boulderfist Ogre historical T3: 6/7 =13 printed SP; Greedy has +1 body SP plus a conditional reward.
units.premium: Oversized immediate body at Tier 3; a separate Golden-sale route can high-roll a strategic capstone.
units.text: If this is Golden when you sell it, Discover a Tier 7 minion.

units.name: Handless Forsaken
units.setup: Unbuffed 2/1 Hand and its Reborn both fit; no extra trigger engine.
units.basis: 2 Hand lives x(2+1) =6 extra SP; own body 3 +6 -Harmless Bonehead effective 6 =3 marginal/fight. At +2 Undead Attack both packages gain three recipients, so marginal remains ~3.
units.compare_to: Harmless Bonehead T1: two 1/1 Skeletons =4 extra SP, effective 6 total.
units.premium: More Attack per death body, with Reborn requiring less simultaneous free space.
units.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 2/1 Hand with Reborn.

units.name: Hired Mount
units.setup: Activate once for 2 gold; random Chromadrake is useful as a ~3-gold card including its Battlecry; precise colour/target distribution unknown.
units.basis: One useful generated minion card ~3 gold -2 activation =1 net gold/turn; Clever Castaway offers ~2.5 gold of chosen spell utility -2 activation =0.5. Marginal (1-0.5)x3.5 =1.75. Chromadrake Battlecry utility is included in its 3-gold card estimate, not added as free stats; persistent spell-counter upside is not resolved.
units.compare_to: Intrepid Botanist T2: ~6 SP/turn per persistent spell-stat counter; Clever Castaway T2 ~0.5 net gold/turn.
units.premium: A repeatable body/Battlecry supplier with several different rewards, not a guaranteed stat package.
units.text: Activate (2): Get a random Chromadrake.

units.name: Iron Groundskeeper
units.setup: Both generated Fortify spells cast on retained minions, +3 Health each.
units.basis: 2 Fortify x3 Health =6 permanent SP once; Razorfen's 4 once is the flexible stat alternative, so (6-4)/2 =1 marginal. Taunt can help or hurt; spell gold value not added.
units.compare_to: Razorfen Geomancer T1: 4 permanent SP once via two base Gems.
units.premium: Two extra Health and guaranteed Taunt access, plus two Tavern-spell triggers.
units.text: Battlecry: Get 2 copies of Fortify.

units.name: Locked-up Mutineer
units.setup: Mutineer dies each fight, advancing an existing Lockbox; first box ~five turns, steady state conservatively one useful Golden per ~four fights; 80% reward realisation, ~4 gold-equivalent utility each.
units.basis: 4 reward-equivalent gold x0.8/4 turns =0.8 gold/turn; Bilgewater Breakout benchmark ~0.5/turn gives (0.8-0.5)x3.5 =1.05 marginal. Never count each acceleration as a separate Golden.
units.compare_to: Bilgewater Breakout T2: one delayed/accelerated box, ~0.5 discounted gold-equivalent/turn.
units.premium: Recurring death acceleration rather than one Battlecry; premium depends on not wasting speed after a box opens.
units.text: Deathrattle: Get a Lockbox. If you already have one, it opens 1 turn sooner instead.

units.name: Malchezaar, Prince of Dance
units.comps: Demon health economy; Soul Rewinder; shop search
units.setup: Use both health-paid refreshes each recruit; Soul Rewinder prevents the hero-health loss.
units.basis: 2 refreshes x1 saved gold =2 gold/turn; versus Accord-o-Tron's 1/turn yields (2-1)x3.5 =3.5 marginal. Rewinder's own Health gains are donor-trigger synergies, not counted again as Malchezaar stats.
units.compare_to: Ominous Seer T1: 1-gold discount once, ~0.5 gold/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Two repeatable searches per turn paid in a resource that a Tier 2 unit can neutralize.
units.text: Two Refreshes each turn cost Health instead of Gold. (2 left!)

units.name: Mangled Bandit
units.setup: Discard one otherwise spare generated card worth 0.5 gold; three Gems currently +2/+2; existing discard payoffs excluded.
units.basis: 3 Gems x4 SP =12 gross permanent SP/turn -0.5x3.5 =10.25 net; Roadboar at two attacks yields 2x4 =8, so marginal 2.25. At base Gems gross output is 6, not 12.
units.compare_to: Roadboar T2: two current 4-SP Gems =8 permanent SP/turn after combat lag.
units.premium: One extra Gem and recruit timing in exchange for a discarded card.
units.text: Activate (0): Discard a card to get 3 Blood Gems.

units.name: Mummifier
units.comps: Undead Reborn; death chains; attack aura
units.setup: Grants Reborn to a non-Reborn Handless Forsaken with +2 Undead Attack; it dies with room for the copy and both Hand lives.
units.basis: Reborn Handless Forsaken returns 4/1 =5 SP, then two 4/1 Hand lives =10, total 15; 80% target/space realisation gives 12 added combat SP. Scarlet Skull with the same +2 Undead Attack adds 5 Reborn-body SP plus two 3-SP buffs =11; source bodies are 9 versus 5 SP, so marginal (12-11)+(9-5) =5.
units.compare_to: Scarlet Skull T2: ~11 added combat SP with the same +2 Undead Attack aura; Risen Rider T1 ~5 Reborn-body SP under that aura.
units.premium: Can duplicate an entire deathrattle package, not just one vanilla body.
units.text: Deathrattle: Give a different friendly Undead Reborn.

units.name: Prosthetic Hand
units.setup: Magnetize onto a non-Reborn minion whose original card has 5 Attack; returned copy has 1 Health and loses attachments/buffs.
units.basis: Attachment +3/+1 =4 permanent SP once; Reborn original 5/1 =6 combat SP. Lullabot alternative attaches 4 once plus 1 Health/turn, so marginal 6-1 =5 combat-equivalent per turn; source abilities can increase it.
units.compare_to: Lullabot T1: 4 once plus 1 Health/turn; Risen Rider T1 provides Reborn only on itself.
units.premium: Transfers Reborn onto a chosen Mech or Undead, allowing an important deathrattle or aura to act twice.
units.text: Magnetic, Reborn Can Magnetize to Mechs or Undead.

units.name: Relentless Deflector
units.comps: Mech tokens; avenge deaths; shield refresh
units.setup: Six friendly deaths occur while this survives; two Avenge shields each block an 8-Attack hit; no initial shield unless granted.
units.basis: 6/3 =2 shield gains x8 avoided damage =16 combat SP; Bronze Warden benchmark has 2x4 shields +3 Reborn =11, so marginal ~5. Overlapping refreshes or early snipes reduce this sharply.
units.compare_to: Bronze Warden T2: two shields and a 2/1 Reborn, ~11 added combat SP against 4-Attack hits.
units.premium: Repeatable shield restoration linked to deaths, rather than a fixed two-life shield budget.
units.text: Has Taunt while this has Divine Shield. Avenge (3): Gain Divine Shield.

units.name: Rescue Bot
units.comps: Mech sacrifice; targeted carry buffs; Tavern spells
units.setup: Dies once/fight, generated Repair Job (+4/+8) cast next recruit on a retained minion; no Reborn or multipliers.
units.basis: 1 Repair Job x12 SP =12 permanent SP/turn with combat lag; Roadboar supplies ~4/turn at two attacks, but Rescue Bot's 3-SP body versus Roadboar's 6 loses ~3 tempo SP, so marginal 12-4-3 =5. Do not also count 2-gold spell utility.
units.compare_to: Roadboar T2: ~4 permanent SP/turn at two base-Gem Rallies.
units.premium: One large directed spell from a reliable Taunt death, with a severe source-body tempo tax.
units.text: Taunt Deathrattle: Get a Repair Job.

units.name: Roaring Recruiter
units.setup: Four attacks by other Dragons while Recruiter lives; no combat-stat retention in this baseline.
units.basis: 4 other Dragon attacks x(+3/+1) =16 temporary SP. Electric Synthesizer adds 6 combat SP; source bodies are 10 versus 7. Marginal (16-6)+(10-7) =13 per fight with previously retained buffs held fixed. Synthesizer's one-off Battlecry is separately listed on its row; combat retention would change the value basis.
units.compare_to: Electric Synthesizer T2: 6 permanent once and 6 combat SP on three Dragons.
units.premium: Four stats per friendly attack, rewarding repeated attacks and retention support.
units.text: Whenever another friendly Dragon attacks, give it +3/+1.

units.name: Shoalfin Mystic
units.setup: Sell Mystic; three stat-granting Tavern spells/turn averaging two retained targets.
units.basis: 3 spells x2 targets x(+1/+1) =12 permanent SP/turn; Intrepid Botanist's one-stat upgrade gives 6, so marginal 6. Only realised targets counted, not every spell in the deck.
units.compare_to: Intrepid Botanist T2: ~6 SP/turn in the same six-target-event setup.
