units.text: When you sell this, your Tavern spells give an extra +1/+1 this game.

units.name: Sly Infiltrator
units.setup: Choose two free refreshes, one purchase per two-turn comparison; no Trailblazer.
units.basis: 2 refreshes /2 turns =1 gold/turn; versus Ominous Seer's 0.5 gives (1-0.5)x3.5 =1.75 marginal. Alternative 3-Gem mode is 6 permanent SP once at base size, or 12 with +2/+2 Gems, not additive.
units.compare_to: Ominous Seer T1: one 1-gold spell discount, ~0.5 gold/turn.
units.premium: Two refreshes or a flexible Gem packet, both available with Trailblazer.
units.text: Choose One - Gain 2 free Refreshes; or Get 3 Blood Gems.

units.name: Sprightly Scarab
units.setup: Choose +1/+1 and Reborn on a non-Reborn Beast whose original 5 Attack and deathrattle yield ~10 combat SP on a fresh 1-Health copy; no enchanted stats return.
units.basis: Choose Reborn mode on a Beast with an assumed 10-SP fresh Reborn/deathrattle package each fight. Usual Beast effect-slot alternative progressed Tasty Lobster adds 6 combat buff SP, so marginal 10-6 =4/fight, excluding shared cycle-source bodies. Scarab's +1/+1 permanent gift is separately 2 SP once and is not amortized into this combat marginal. Windfury mode is a different option.
units.compare_to: Risen Rider T1: one 2/1 Reborn =3 extra combat SP; Sprightly Scarab can put Reborn onto a Beast with its own deathrattle.
units.premium: Places a deathrattle multiplier on a chosen Beast or supplies an alternative Windfury attack route.
units.text: Choose One - Give a Beast +1/+1 and Reborn; or +4 Attack and Windfury.

units.name: Tasty Lobster
units.setup: Assume one previous improvement raised current death buff from +2/+1 to +4/+2; one living Beast receives it.
units.basis: Current +4/+2 =6 combat SP; own 3 body +6 =9 effective. Handless Forsaken also gives effective 9 unbuffed, so current-fight marginal ~0. Future-Lobster increment assumed +2/+1, but no retained recruit stats are credited for future combat buffs.
units.compare_to: Scarlet Skull T2: two +1/+2 death buffs =6 combat SP plus a Reborn body, usually a stronger generic death-buffer.
units.premium: Future-card progression rather than permanent buffs to the current board; needs repeated Lobster access.
units.text: Deathrattle: Give a random friendly Beast +2/+1. Improve your future Tasty Lobsters.

units.name: Thorned Trailblazer
units.comps: Quilboar Choose One; Gem Day; Foodie
units.setup: One Gem Day/turn from an existing Gem Rat, ten other-source Gems/turn, current Gems +2/+2; baseline chooses one Gem Day stat and Trailblazer adds the other.
units.basis: Added Gem Day branch gives +1 of the other stat per future Gem: 10 Gems x1 =10 extra permanent SP/turn from the new combined choice. Alternative Roadboar generates two current 4-SP Gems =8, so marginal 10-8 =2. Already accumulated upgrade stock is held equal; at only six Gems/turn this substitution is negative.
units.compare_to: Roadboar T2: two +2/+2 Gems =8 permanent SP/turn in this setup; Crater Miner T2 supplies just one Gem Day once.
units.premium: An extra Choose One branch each turn; marginal value follows that branch, not a flat doubling of the composition.
units.text: One Choose One card each turn has both effects combined. (1 left!)

units.name: Timecap'n Hooktail
units.setup: Seven retained units, three Tavern spells cast/turn; both Blood Gems and Spellcraft are excluded from Tavern-spell count.
units.basis: 3 Tavern spells x7 minions x1 Attack =21 permanent SP/turn; best passive early wide-buffer alternative Surfing Sylvar with one Golden gives 4, so marginal 17. Can be sold after triggers; cost of casting spells is shared by both alternatives.
units.compare_to: Surfing Sylvar T2: two neighbours x2 casts =4 Attack/turn with one Golden.
units.premium: Board-wide output per spell, allowing multiple full-board buffs each turn at Tier 3.
units.text: Whenever you cast a Tavern spell, give your minions +1 Attack.

units.name: Trapped Clapper
units.setup: Dies once/fight; use all next three refreshes; each automatically eaten Fodder assumed worth 6 SP after shop bonuses.
units.basis: 3 automatic Fodder meals x6 assumed SP =18 permanent SP/turn; Laboratory Assistant gives the same 18 once, ~9/turn over two-turn horizon, so marginal 9. First combat's output is delayed to next recruit; no need to buy Fodder.
units.compare_to: Laboratory Assistant T2: ~18 permanent SP once from three meals in this same assumed shop.
units.premium: Repeats a three-meal packet every fight, with a fragile 2/2 source and refresh requirement.
units.text: Deathrattle: Add a Fodder to your next 3 Refreshes.

units.name: Treasure Parrot
units.comps: Beast Fishbait; buffed Pirate/Beast; Golden rewards
units.setup: Invest enough buffs to deal 35 total damage in about four turns; Golden Touch shop spell worth listed 5 gold; use one-shot quest only.
units.basis: 5-gold spell /4 turns =1.25 gold-equivalent/turn; versus Busker one-gold rebate /2 =0.5 gives (1.25-0.5)x3.5 =2.625. Buff cost shared only if this is an existing carry; if bought solely to quest, subtract that investment. No recurring post-reward income.
units.compare_to: Southsea Busker T1: 1 delayed gold once, ~0.5 gold/turn over two turns.
units.premium: A large delayed Golden-enabling payout, with damage progress rather than passive waiting.
units.text: Once this deals 35 damage, get a Golden Touch. (35 left!)

units.name: Trench Fighter
units.comps: Quilboar Gem carry transfer; shield carry
units.setup: One Gem Confiscation generated/turn; three Gems currently +2/+2 played onto a retained carry; neighbours' existing Gems only move.
units.basis: 3 new Gems x4 SP =12 permanent SP/turn; Roadboar at two attacks generates 2x4 =8, so marginal 4. Stolen neighbour Gem stats are zero net board growth; moving them onto a shield carry may improve combat efficiency.
units.compare_to: Roadboar T2: ~8 permanent SP/turn with two current 4-SP Gems.
units.premium: Three guaranteed Gems plus a redistribution tool every turn, without needing to attack.
units.text: At the end of your turn, get a Gem Confiscation.

units.name: Unwilling Slacker
units.setup: Dies each fight; random 1-Cost Tavern spell useful and cast next recruit; no multiplier.
units.basis: One 1-cost spell =1 gold-equivalent/turn, not 3; Accord-o-Tron gives 1 actual gold/turn, so marginal (1-1)x3.5 =0. Deity death and spell triggers can make Slacker the preferred synergy slot.
units.compare_to: Ominous Seer T1: one 1-gold discount once, ~0.5 gold/turn over two turns.
units.premium: Repeatable spell/death triggers rather than a larger raw resource rebate.
units.text: Deathrattle: Get a random 1-Cost Tavern spell.

units.name: Vicious Mindslasher
units.setup: Three Tavern spells/turn; each buffs self and persistent Deity by +1/+2; Deity awakens; spell costs common to alternative.
units.basis: 3 spells x2 recipients x3 SP =18 permanent SP/turn, half on reserve Deity. Brain Rotter adds 4 minus spare-card cost 0.5x3.5 =2.25 net, so marginal 18-2.25 =15.75. Does not count C'Thun's later combat redistribution as more permanent growth.
units.compare_to: Brain Rotter T2: +4 Deity SP/turn, ~2.25 net after a spare-card opportunity cost.
units.premium: Six permanent stats per Tavern spell, split across a board carry and an off-board carry.
units.text: Whenever you cast a Tavern spell, give this and your Deity +1/+2.

units.name: Waveling
units.setup: Dies once to establish one lasting refresh modifier; three refreshes/turn, average 0.4 of that roll's buffed card is retained or consumed; no second death copy assumed.
units.basis: 3 refreshes x0.4 realised cards x(+4/+4) =9.6, rounded 10 permanent SP/turn; Dune Dweller gives two Elementals x2 =4, so marginal ~6. Repeated fights can add modifiers, but that ramp is deliberately excluded.
units.compare_to: Dune Dweller T1: ~4 permanent SP/turn at two Elemental acquisitions.
units.premium: A much larger shop buff, any minion can receive it, paid for with random targeting and a death trigger.
units.text: Deathrattle: After the Tavern is Refreshed this game, give a random minion in it +4/+4.

units.name: Waverider
units.setup: Follow CSV literally: +2/+2 has no expiry; Windfury alone says until next turn. One Naga with 8 Attack survives the extra attack; duration interpretation uncertain.
units.basis: New +2/+2 contributes 4 SP in this fight; Windfury yields one useful 8-Attack extra swing =8 combat-equivalent SP. Usual Deep-Sea Angler alternative gives 8 temporary SP, so marginal (4+8)-8 =4/fight. Literal CSV wording also makes the +2/+2 permanent, recorded separately in sp_per_turn; accumulated earlier buffs are held fixed.
units.compare_to: Mini-Myrmidon T1: 2 temporary Attack/turn; Deep-Sea Angler T3 +8 temporary SP; earlier Waverider variants were also T4.
units.premium: Reusable Windfury on a chosen Naga carry; permanent-stat interpretation must be confirmed before budgeting as a scaler.
units.text: Spellcraft: Give a minion +2/+2. If it's a Naga, also give it Windfury until next turn.

units.name: Wildfire Elemental
units.comps: Elemental high-Attack carry; anti-small adjacent targets
units.setup: Attack-buffed to 12 Attack, kills a 6-Health enemy; overflow reaches one useful neighbour; shared carry buffs excluded.
units.basis: One 12-6 =6 overflow damage treated as 6 combat-equivalent SP; no-bonus alternative has 0 overflow. Versus Crackling Cyclone's assumed 4-SP useful shield/Windfury advantage at this stage, marginal ~2. Shielded neighbours or no overkill yield 0.
units.compare_to: Crackling Cyclone T1: buffable shield/Windfury shell, ~4 realised keyword SP in this damage-heavy matchup.
units.premium: Conditional adjacent damage rather than extra attacks; depends on enemy geometry and Health, not permanent growth.
units.text: After this attacks and kills a minion, deal excess damage to an adjacent enemy.

units.name: Wolf Pup
units.setup: Already have Lurking Lionfish; Wolf Pup attacks Fishbait once in recruit and attacks once in combat; five other retained units benefit in each phase.
units.basis: One fight: 5 other survivors x(+4/+1) =25 combat buff SP. Wolf Pup body is 9 SP; usual Beast-slot alternative Humming Bird is 5 body SP plus ~6 combat Attack across useful Beast bodies. Marginal (9+25)-(5+6) =23 SP/fight. In the stated Lionfish setup a separate recruit Rally also grants 25 retained SP/turn, listed in sp_per_turn; that growth and Fishbait's own +10 SP are not added to this combat marginal.
units.compare_to: Lurking Lionfish T2: +10 gross permanent SP/turn for 2 gold, ~3 net before same-slot alternatives; Humming Bird T2 ~6 temporary Attack/fight.
units.premium: Board-wide +5 SP per target from a recruit-phase attack; without Fishbait this is only temporary combat scaling.
units.text: Rally: Give your other minions +4/+1.

units.name: Abyssal Bruiser
units.text: Divine Shield Has +2/+1 for each Tavern spell you've cast this game.
units.setup: Turn 9; 12 historical Tavern spells and 3 new casts per turn; normal version.
units.basis: 3 casts x (2 Attack+1 Health)=9 permanent growth/turn; historical aura already supplies 36 SP, excluded from new growth. Shield avoids roughly a 20-Attack hit. Available cheap spell carry Fleeing Fugitive gains 3 Health/turn: 9-3=6 marginal permanent SP.
units.compare_to: Fleeing Fugitive T1: 3 casts x +1 Health = 3/turn.
units.premium: Three stats per spell plus retroactive scaling and Divine Shield make a credible carry.

units.name: Air Baller
units.text: When you sell this, give your minions +2/+2. Improve your future Ballers.
units.setup: Turn 8; sell one fresh Air Baller into six retained minions each turn; no accumulated Baller upgrades.
units.basis: Sale: 6 targets x (+2/+2)=24 permanent SP once per copy. Fire/Snow Baller in the same cycle slot gives 6 SP, so one sale/turn improves 24-6=18. Future Baller improvement is additional upside, not priced because increment is absent from the CSV.
units.compare_to: Fire Baller or Snow Baller T2: 6 targets x +1 stat = 6/sale at unscaled base.
units.premium: Board-wide two-sided buffs replace a single-stat buff; also advances the shared Baller engine.

units.name: Ashen Corruptor
units.text: After your hero takes damage, rewind it and give minions in the Tavern +2/+2 this turn.
units.setup: Turn 8; 3 self-damage triggers before two shop bodies are consumed or retained; no older shop buffs.
units.basis: 3 triggers x +2/+2 x 2 transferred shop bodies =24 permanent SP/turn, counting only stats actually absorbed. Same healing slot Soul Rewinder gets 3 x 2 Health=6: 24-6=18. Shop-only stats left behind are worth zero here; hero damage prevention is unpriced.
units.compare_to: Soul Rewinder T2: same 3 damage triggers give 6 Health/turn and the same damage rewind.
units.premium: Moves scaling off one support body and onto every shop body that the composition can absorb.

units.name: Banana Slamma
units.text: After you summon a Beast in combat, double its Attack.
units.setup: Turn 9; four Beasts are summoned in combat with 20 Attack each before Slamma; one Slamma survives all four.
units.basis: Doubling adds 4 x 20=80 combat Attack. Humming Bird alternative adds about 8 Attack over eight relevant Beast bodies, so 80-8=72 marginal combat SP per round. Attack only: current CSV does not double Health; old strategy notes describe an earlier version.
units.compare_to: Humming Bird T2: roughly eight Beast bodies x +1 Attack = 8 combat SP.
units.premium: Scales with the size of summons instead of adding a flat amount to each body.

units.name: Bigwig Bandit
units.text: Rally: Get a random Bounty.
units.setup: Turn 8; 1.25 attacks per combat on average; uniform draw among five Bounties; cards used next recruit phase.
units.basis: Uniform five-Bounty model: buff Bounties average(16+16+12)/5=8.8 permanent SP per draw, plus Wealthy2/5=0.4 liquid gold and Friendly3/5=0.6 card-equivalent gold. At3.5 SP/gold, each draw is12.3 SP-equivalent;1.25 draws=15.4/round. Unwilling Slacker alternative gives about3.5 SP/round, raw marginal11.9; conservatively use8 for delayed/random value and lost tempo. gold_per_turn is the alternative face-value accounting:1.25 x(4 spells x2 gold+1 minion x3 gold)/5=2.75, not added again to12.3. Marginal split after the existing conservative discount: about7 permanent buff SP plus1 economy SP-equivalent=8 per turn; the undiscounted split is11 permanent SP plus(1.25-1) gold-equivalent x3.5=0.875 economy SP-equivalent.
units.compare_to: Unwilling Slacker T3: one random 1-cost Tavern spell per death, about 1 gold or 3.5 SP/round.
units.premium: Repeated attacks can generate multiple useful cards; Bounty support raises their ceiling.

units.name: Blade Collector
units.text: Also damages the enemies next to whomever this attacks.
units.setup: Turn 9; external buffs make this 30 Attack; two effective adjacent targets across its attacks, with overkill discount.
units.basis: Cleave supplies about 2 x 30 x 0.83=50 useful extra damage, treated as combat SP; no stats or buff engine credited to the Collector itself. Wildfire Elemental flex slot supplies about 25 effective excess damage: 50-25=25 marginal combat-equivalent SP.
units.compare_to: Wildfire Elemental T3: approximately 25 useful splash damage from a similarly buffed carry, conditional on a kill.
units.premium: Hits neighbours without first killing its target, multiplying concentrated buffs.

units.name: Bonker
units.text: Windfury Rally: This plays a Blood Gem on all your other minions.
units.setup: Turn 9; survives two Windfury attacks; six other minions; Gems are+3/+3; no recruit-phase Rally trigger.
units.basis: Two Rallies x6 allies x6 SP/Gem=72 temporary combat SP. Prodigious Tusker alternative with six allied attacks gives6 x6=36, so72-36=36 marginal combat SP/round. Combat Gems expire after combat; permanent output0. If Gems are only+2/+1, gross falls to36 and marginal18; if Bonker attacks once, gross36.
units.compare_to: Prodigious Tusker T2: six allied attacks x one +3/+3 Gem = 36 combat SP.
units.premium: Two early attacks can distribute twelve Gems before the board trades down.

units.name: Boom-in-a-Box
units.text: Taunt Start of Combat: Deal 3 damage to all other minions.
units.setup: Turn 8; enemies have two valuable Divine Shields and six exposed bodies; your board tolerates 3 damage.
units.basis: Six enemies x 3=18 damage plus about 24 SP of shield-breaking utility minus about 21 self-damage opportunity cost =21 net combat-equivalent SP. Spare generic tech body worth about 14 gives 21-14=7; very matchup dependent. Neither the 5/10 body nor beneficial deathrattle chains are added.
units.compare_to: Red Whelp T1 (historical): six Dragons give about 6 damage to one enemy; roughly 6 combat SP before shield utility.
units.premium: Simultaneous whole-board shield breaking and friendly damage triggers, with a substantial friendly-fire cost.

units.name: Bramble Tunneler
units.text: Rally: Get a random Choose One card.
units.setup: Turn 8; attacks once; generated Choose One card is usable next turn; no Trailblazer multiplication included.
units.basis: 1 useful random card x 3 gold-equivalent =3/round; 3 x 3.5=10.5 SP-equivalent. Versus Roadboar producing one +2/+2 Gem worth 4 SP, marginal=10.5-4=6.5. Random card value is a judgement, not guaranteed liquid gold. Marginal split: +10.5 economy SP-equivalent minus4 permanent Gem SP from the alternative=6.5 per turn.
units.compare_to: Roadboar T2: one Rally gives one Gem; about 4 SP at +2/+2 Gems.
units.premium: Trades a small known currency reward for a whole Choose One card and its scaling/economy options.

units.name: Bream Counter
units.text: While this is in your hand, after you play a Murloc, gain +6/+6.
units.comps: Murloc handbuff with Diremuck Forager/Expert Aviator
units.setup: Turn 9; three Murlocs played each turn; this stays in hand and is summoned in combat by a hand-summoner.
units.basis: 3 plays x +6/+6=36 permanent hand stats/turn; counted as board-realizable only because a summoner actually deploys it each fight. Very Hungry Winterfinner alternative with four damage events gives 4 x 3=12 hand SP: 36-12=24. Without a summoner, immediate board realization is zero.
units.compare_to: Very Hungry Winterfinner T2: four damage events x +2/+1 =12 hand SP/round.
units.premium: Hand growth scales with controlled Murloc cycling rather than surviving damage; can stay safely off-board.

units.name: Bronze Timewalker
units.text: Rally: Get a random Chromadrake.
units.setup: Turn 8; one Rally per fight; generated Chromadrake played next turn, using the supplied five-colour token family.
units.basis: One generated Chromadrake roughly 3 card-equivalent gold or 10.5 SP/round; direct Battlecry stats depend on colour and are not added again. Hired Mount generates the same card for 2 gold: marginal saving 2 x 3.5=7 SP/round, before attack risk.
units.compare_to: Hired Mount T3: same random Chromadrake per turn for Activate (2), net about 1 card-equivalent gold.
units.premium: Makes an existing generation effect free in gold, conditional on reaching an attack.

units.name: Cage Gnawer
units.text: Whenever a friendly Beast attacks, give your Beasts +2/+1.
units.comps: Beast Fishbait recruit attacks; Beast wide combat
units.setup: Turn 9; three Fishbait recruit attacks distributed one each across three Beasts; four retained Beasts total; six combat attacks with three Beasts alive on average.
units.basis: Recruit attacks:3 x4 retained Beasts x(+2/+1)=36 permanent SP/turn. Combat attacks:6 x3 average live Beasts x3=54 temporary SP, separate from recruit growth. Best usual Wolf Pup alternative attacks once in the same distributed attack pattern and buffs three retained allies:1 x3 x5=15 permanent SP; marginal36-15=21. A setup focusing every attack on Wolf Pup can reverse this comparison. Without Fishbait, permanent output0.
units.compare_to: Wolf Pup T3: one recruit Rally xthree retained other allies x(+4/+1)=15 permanent SP; each combat Rally similarly buffs its surviving allies.
units.premium: Every Beast attack scales every surviving Beast, including attacks during recruiting.

units.name: Cagey Conjurer
units.text: Activate (1): Cast 2 random Tavern spells (targets this if possible).
units.setup: Turn 8; Activate once for 1 gold; each random spell averages 3 useful permanent SP plus 3 from Humon'gozz; otherwise random effects can miss.
units.basis: 2 casts x (3 expected direct SP+3 aura SP)=12 permanent SP. Pay 1 gold x 3.5=3.5 opportunity SP, net 8.5. Spare Waverider gives 4 permanent SP free, so 8.5-4=4.5 marginal. The two spells are cast immediately, not kept or sold; no extra gold value is added. Marginal split: +(12-4)=8 permanent SP minus3.5 economy SP-equivalent activation cost=4.5 per turn.
units.compare_to: Waverider T3: one free +2/+2 Spellcraft =4 permanent SP/turn, plus temporary Naga Windfury.
units.premium: Two automatic casts accelerate cast counters and buff auras for a small gold cost.

units.name: Conveyor Construct
units.text: Deathrattle: Get a random Magnetic Volumizer.
units.setup: Turn 8; dies once each fight, free hand slot, resulting Volumizer used next recruit phase.
units.basis: One generated Magnetic minion x 3 gold-equivalent=3/round, about 10.5 SP-equivalent. Unwilling Slacker yields a 1-cost spell, about 3.5 SP; marginal 10.5-3.5=7. Volumizer stats and counter upgrades are bundled into the card value, not counted a second time.
units.compare_to: Auto Accelerator T3: same random Volumizer once on Battlecry, about 3 card-equivalent gold once rather than each death.
units.premium: A repeatable combat death supplies scaling Magnetic cards without repeated purchases.

units.name: Cutthroat K'Thir
units.text: Whenever you discard a card, give this and your Deity +4/+4.
units.setup: Turn 9; three discards per turn; both this and the Deity are relevant; Deity awakens in typical fights.
units.basis: 3 discards x 2 recipients x (+4/+4)=48 permanent SP in this plus stored Deity stats. Deity half is latent, credited only with reliable awakening. Usual Vicious Mindslasher alternative at three Tavern spells gives 3 x 2 x (+1/+2)=18: 48-18=30. If the Deity fails to awaken, realized Cutthroat output is only 24.
units.compare_to: Vicious Mindslasher T3: three Tavern spells x 2 recipients x 3 SP =18/turn with Deity deployment.
units.premium: More than doubles per-trigger two-body growth and rewards the tribe's discard currency.

units.name: Dead Bellringer
units.text: Activate (1): Give a different friendly Undead Reborn. Then destroy it to gain +4/+4.
units.setup: Turn 9; Activate on an unbuffed4/2 Plaguerunner; six other retained Undead including Bellringer; all survive the recruit action; returned Plaguerunner not counted as a seventh buff recipient.
units.basis: Outside-combat Plaguerunner death adds6 retained Undead x4 Attack=24 persistent SP; Bellringer gains8 SP; Plaguerunner returns at1 Health, losing1 Health:24+8-1=31 net permanent SP. Pay1 gold=3.5 opportunity SP, leaving27.5. Graverobber alternative can trigger the same24-Attack death once per found copy; one copy per three turns averages8, so marginal27.5-8=19.5. This baseline assumes limited Graverobber availability; plentiful cycling narrows the gap. The returned Plaguerunner has used up Reborn. Marginal split: +(31-8)=23 permanent SP minus3.5 economy SP-equivalent activation cost=19.5 per turn.
units.compare_to: Disguised Graverobber T3: one outside-combat death trigger gives24 Attack to six retained Undead here, once per found copy; roughly8/turn at one copy per three rounds.
units.premium: Once-per-turn targeted recruit deathrattles plus self growth; preserves a usable reborn replacement.

units.name: Drone Duplicator
units.text: Divine Shield. Activate (1): The next Magnetization to this minion this turn happens an extra time.
units.setup: Turn 9; once per turn Magnetize a 6/6 card onto this; next Magnetization only; no duplicated economy text credited.
units.basis: One extra Magnetization copies 6+6=12 permanent SP; shield prevents about 15 damage in a typical fight. Activate costs 1 gold or 3.5 SP. Mechagnome Interpreter alternative on two Magnetic plays gives 2 x (+3/+1)=8 SP: 12-3.5-8=0.5 marginal. Bigger Volumizers or copied engines raise this sharply. Marginal split: +(12-8)=4 permanent SP minus3.5 economy SP-equivalent activation cost=0.5 per turn.
units.compare_to: Mechagnome Interpreter T2: two Mech plays/Magnetizations x +3/+1 =8 permanent SP/turn.
units.premium: Copies a whole attachment and its text onto a shielded carry, rather than adding a flat play buff.

units.name: En-Djinn Blazer
units.text: Battlecry: After the Tavern is Refreshed this game, give a random minion in it +10/+10.
units.comps: Elemental refresh/shop buffs; Demon consume hybrid
units.setup: Turn 8; three refreshes/turn; one of the +10/+10 marked bodies is retained or consumed per turn.
units.basis: Permanent Battlecry shop rule gives +20 SP on a random shop body per refresh; three refreshes create 60 shop SP, but only one marked body is transferred, so realized=20/turn. Waveling adds +4/+4 in the same realized target: 20-8=12 marginal. No immediate Battlecry stats, and selling Blazer retains the rule.
units.compare_to: Waveling T3: one Deathrattle grants +4/+4 per refresh; same one retained marked body realizes 8 SP/turn.
units.premium: An immediate, persistent refresh rule with 2.5 times the buff per hit.

units.name: Enchanted Sentinel
units.text: Magnetic Your Tavern spells give an extra +1/+1.
units.setup: Turn 8; four relevant single-target Tavern buff spells and two Mech plays/Magnetizations per turn; Sentinel magnetized onto a retained Mech.
units.basis: 4 Tavern buff spells x(+1/+1)=8 extra permanent SP/turn; Magnetic transfers printed3+5=8 SP once. Mechagnome Interpreter on two Mech plays gives2 x(+3/+1)=8, so direct growth marginal8-8=0. Sentinel can be attached and free a final board slot, whereas Interpreter must stay; slot value is substantial but unpriced. Shoalfin Mystic grants the same spell rule on sale, another reason not to claim a raw-stat premium.
units.compare_to: Shoalfin Mystic T3: sell once to grant the same +1/+1 Tavern-spell bonus, worth 8/turn in this setup without occupying a slot.
units.premium: Magnetic makes a live stack of the spell aura cost no extra final board slot.

units.name: Faceless Operative
units.text: When you sell this, get 2 random Aberrations. When you play one, discard the other.
units.setup: Turn 9; buy/sell one copy each turn; play one generated Aberration and discard the other; Cutthroat already present; Deity awakens in half of relevant fights.
units.basis: Two generated cards are linked: only one playable minion remains after the mandatory discard. Useful card value3 minus net buy/sell cost2=1 gold-equivalent per cycle, equal to a Tad-style card cycle, so pure economy marginal0. The extra discard adds8 self SP to Cutthroat plus8 latent Deity SP x0.5 awakening=12 realized SP. Compared with a normal one-card sale cycle that makes no discard, marginal12. This is synergy output, not intrinsic Operative stats; without Cutthroat or another discard payoff, marginal0.
units.compare_to: Tad T2: same one3-gold useful tribe card from a2-gold net buy/sell cycle; Brain Rotter T2 supplies a free-Activate discard outlet but consumes a hand card.

units.name: Choral Mrrrglr
units.text: Start of Combat: Gain the stats of all the minions in your hand.
units.setup: Hand contains a 60/60 and a 40/40 minion; enemy meaningful hits average 40 damage.
units.basis: Copies (60+60)+(40+40) = 200 SP into combat, lost afterward. Costume Enthusiast copies the largest Attack (60) and has one shield (~40), about 100 combat SP. Marginal in-fight value is 200-100 = 100 SP/fight, hence 100 SP/turn at one fight per turn. Handbuff production belongs to the buffers.
units.compare_to: Costume Enthusiast T5 (current): about 60 copied Attack + 40 shield value = 100 combat SP in this hand.
units.premium: Copies Health as well as Attack and reads the entire hand; protects the value of keeping multiple large minions off-board.

units.name: Crimson Vindicator
units.text: Divine Shield Rally: Cast Mighty Dragonbreath.
units.comps: Dragon Rally; Dragon spell buffs with Persistent Poet
units.setup: Two Rally attacks; average spell hits 6 allies, including 4 Dragons and 2 shielded units; two shielded Dragons are protected by Persistent Poet.
units.basis: Mighty Dragonbreath gives 5 SP per eligible pass: 2 x (6+4+2) x 5 = 120 combat buff SP, plus ~40 for its printed shield = 160 total effect value. Poet preserves 2 recipients x 3 passes x 5 SP x 2 casts = 60 permanently; the remaining 100 is temporary combat value. Runic Arcanist supplies 24 total SP per fight, of which 8 is retained and 16 temporary. Mixed marginal split: permanent 60-8 = 52 SP/turn, plus in_fight 100-16 = 84 SP/fight; total 136 at one fight per turn. Retained gains are counted once, not again as combat value. Without Poet the same 136 total premium is entirely in_fight.
units.compare_to: Runic Arcanist T4 (current): two Shiny Rings, about 24 combat SP on six allies; 8 SP/turn retained on the same two Poet-protected Dragons.
units.premium: Large repeated spell passes reward Dragons plus shields; Poet can turn the finisher into permanent scaling.

units.name: Dark Puppeteer
units.text: Deathrattle: Your Tavern spells give an extra +4 Health this game.
units.setup: Three ordinary deaths accumulated while held; four single-target permanent stat Tavern spells cast in the next recruit phase.
units.basis: Three deaths bank +12 Health per qualifying spell; 4 spells x 12 = 48 SP/turn at this age. One new death adds another 16 SP to subsequent turns, not immediate board stats. Felfire Conjurer at three end turns banks +3/+3 per spell, 4 x 6 = 24; margin 24. Assumes one applicable recipient per spell and that the bonus survives combat as this game says.
units.compare_to: Felfire Conjurer T5 (current): at the same three-turn age, +3/+3 spell power x four spells = 24 SP/turn; Friendly Geist T4 adds 1 Attack per death instead.
units.premium: Twice the SP per single upgrade and a Deathrattle that can be retriggered; output depends on spells actually cast afterward.

units.name: Deathly Striker
units.text: Avenge (4): Get a random Undead. Deathrattle: Summon it from your hand for this combat only.
units.setup: Twelve other friendly deaths occur while it lives on a supported Reborn/token board; generates three Undead, then conservatively credit one 24-SP summon with board space.
units.basis: 12/4 = 3 generated random Undead, valued at 3 x 3 = 9 gold-equivalent, or 31.5 opportunity SP at 3.5 SP/gold. Conservatively price one 24-SP summoned body in combat; this temporary summon does not consume or replace the generated permanent hand card. Same-board Lichling Hoarder triggers 12/3 = 4 times, generating 12 gold-equivalent = 42 opportunity SP, with no corresponding summon. Mixed marginal split: economy 31.5-42 = -10.5 SP/turn, plus in_fight 24-0 = 24 SP/fight, total 13.5 at one fight per turn. Deathrattle/hand behavior and survival can vary; this is a supported high-death fight, not an unassisted seven-body board.
units.compare_to: Lichling Hoarder T5 (current): the same twelve deaths yield four plain copies from your starting warband, about 12 gold-equivalent or 42 opportunity SP/turn; random Undead also tend to have worse fit.
units.premium: Adds a hand-to-combat body, but the lower-tier card generator can be the better economy slot.

units.name: Deathstrider
units.text: After a friendly Rally minion attacks, trigger your left-most Deathrattle.
units.setup: Four friendly Rally attacks before Deathstrider dies; left-most Deathrattle is Dark Puppeteer; cast four permanent stat Tavern spells next recruit.
units.basis: Four extra Puppeteer Deathrattles x +4 Health x 4 later spells = 64 extra SP/turn realized next recruit. Ordinary Puppeteer death is shared and excluded. Titus supplies one extra on the ordinary death = 16; margin 48. If no later spells, this model gives zero. With Goldrinn instead, four attacks x 4 affected Beasts x 14 SP = ~224 combat SP, not permanent stats.
units.compare_to: Titus Rivendare T5 (current): one extra Puppeteer death gives 16 SP on four subsequent spells. Monstrous Macaw T4 (past): its own two Rally attacks would give 32 in this setup.
units.premium: Turns every Rally attacker into a retrigger; the capstone is many other units supplying triggers, not a bigger Deathrattle.

units.name: Elemental of Surprise
units.text: Divine Shield This minion can triple with any Elemental.
units.setup: Hold two copies of a useful 6/6 Elemental; replace the on-board normal copy with the resulting golden; one shield blocks a 40-damage hit.
units.basis: Normal-to-golden printed upgrade on the retained carry is roughly 12 SP once, before inherited buffs; the wild-card body is consumed, not an additional 16 SP on board. Shield about 40 combat SP. A triple reward is one extra card (~3 gold-equivalent once), not recurring gold. No ongoing engine upgrade assumed, hence marginal/turn zero. Merging mechanics and chosen target change the one-off substantially.
units.compare_to: Elite Navigator T5 (current): upgrades a Tier 4-or-lower Pirate from normal to golden, roughly +12 printed SP on a 6/6 target once; no extra body required.
units.premium: Wild-card triple access plus Divine Shield and a discover reward, especially valuable when the target is an engine.

units.name: Eredar Escapist
units.text: After your hero takes 4 damage, get a copy of Corrupted Cupcakes. (4 left!)
units.setup: Take 8 recruit-phase hero damage in two 4-damage events; shop minions average 20 SP; free Cupcakes find three meals each.
units.basis: 8/4 = 2 free Corrupted Cupcakes; each Demon consumes 3 minions: 2 x 3 x 20 = 120 retained SP. Two 4-cost spells are 8 gold-equivalent, already represented by the meals. Tichondrius on five Demons and two damage events gives 2 x 5 x 8 = 80; margin 40. Hero health is a real additional constraint; rewinding it must still register damage.
units.compare_to: Tichondrius T5 (current): five Demons x +4/+4 x two damage events = 80 SP/turn. Insatiable Ur'zul T5 with three Demon plays and the same 20-SP shop gives 60.
units.premium: Several shop-size transfers per damage threshold; improved shops let each free spell scale far beyond a fixed buff.

units.name: Falling Sky Golem
units.text: Divine Shield. Has +4/+2 for each Deathrattle you've triggered this game (wherever this is).
units.comps: Deathrattle history into a shielded Mech carry
units.setup: Thirty Deathrattles already triggered; six more each round; four Tavern spells each round; shield absorbs ~40 damage.
units.basis: Retroactive aura at purchase: 30 x (4+2) = 180 SP once above printed body. Future 6 Deathrattles x 6 = 36 persistent SP/turn. Printed shield ~40 combat SP. Abyssal Bruiser grows 4 spells x (2+1) = 12/turn; margin 24. Its own historical spell catch-up is separate and not subtracted from recurring margin.
units.compare_to: Abyssal Bruiser T4 (current): shielded retroactive history payoff, +3 SP per Tavern spell; four new spells = 12 SP/turn, versus this unit's 36 from six Deathrattles.
units.premium: Much larger historical catch-up and growth per event; the shield makes a large single body useful immediately.

units.name: Fauna Whisperer
units.text: At the end of your turn, cast Natural Blessing on adjacent minions.
units.comps: Wide Naga; same-tribe boards; spell-trigger synergies
units.setup: Six Naga including Fauna; both adjacent minions are Naga; no spell multiplier.
units.basis: Natural Blessing gives +2/+1 to all minions sharing the target tribe. Two casts x six Naga x 3 SP = 36 permanent SP/turn. Lightfang with only one tribe buffs one recipient for 8, so margin 28. Different adjacent tribes trade tribe coverage for less overlap.
units.compare_to: Lightfang Enforcer T5 (past, last-pool +4/+4 version): one represented tribe gives 8 SP/turn on this same Naga board, rather than its five-tribe ceiling of 40.
units.premium: Two targeted tribe-wide spells instead of one recipient per tribe; also supplies spell triggers.

units.name: Forsaken Weaver
units.text: After you cast a Tavern spell, your Undead have +3 Attack this game (wherever they are).
units.comps: Undead Tavern-spell attack aura; Reborn swarm
units.setup: Four Tavern spells/turn, five starting Undead, ten additional Undead summons/reborn bodies in combat.
units.basis: 4 x 3 Attack = +12 global Attack/turn; five starting Undead gain 60 permanent board SP. Ten later combat bodies benefit for another 120 Attack in that fight, recorded separately. Plaguerunner one natural death gives +2 global Attack: 10 starting-board SP and 20 on ten summons. Mixed marginal split: permanent 60-10 = 50 SP/turn, plus in_fight 120-20 = 100 SP/fight; total 150 at one fight per turn. Starting-board Attack is counted once, not again in combat. More Deathrattle retriggers can change the best alternative.
units.compare_to: Plaguerunner T4 (current): one natural Deathrattle gives five starting Undead 10 permanent SP/turn; an out-of-combat death would instead give 20.
units.premium: Repeatable recruit-phase global attack growth that is copied onto every future token.

units.name: Gatekeeper Amalgam
units.text: Whenever you cast a spell on this, it casts Misplaced Tea Set.
units.setup: Four spells deliberately target Gatekeeper each recruit; each Tea Set finds five distinct friendly recipients/types.
units.basis: Each Misplaced Tea Set gives five recipients +4/+4 = 40 SP; 4 triggers x 40 = 160 permanent SP/turn. Original targeting spells are common to both boards and excluded. Lightfang buffs the same five recipients for 40, so margin 120. Assumes five recipients, not one extra buff for every tag on the Amalgam; no self-recursive casts assumed.
units.compare_to: Lightfang Enforcer T5 (past, +4/+4 version): five represented recipients x 8 = 40 SP/turn. Same buff packet, but only once at end of turn.
units.premium: Turns each cheap targeted spell into another full menagerie end-of-turn buff.

units.name: Groundbreaker
units.text: After you play a Naga, gain +1/+1. (Improved by every 3 spells you've cast this game!)
units.setup: Thirty spells previously cast; play three Naga per turn; assume each three-spell milestone adds +1/+1 to its trigger.
units.basis: 1+floor(30/3)=11 Attack and Health per Naga, so 3 x 22 = 66 permanent SP/turn. Ignores milestones crossed during this turn. Magmaloc with the same three minion plays gains 2 x (1+3) = 8; margin 58. Milestone improvement size is inferred from the wording and needs implementation confirmation.
units.compare_to: Magmaloc T4 (past): +1/+1 once plus once per minion played, about 8 SP/turn with the same three plays.
units.premium: Retroactive spell history increases every subsequent Naga-play payout, rather than adding one small buff per play.

units.name: Harbinger Aph'lass
units.text: Whenever you discard a card, give your Deity +2/+1 and improve this.
units.comps: Aberration discard into a Deity carry
units.setup: Held through 16 prior discards; discard four more cards/turn; six other minions available for Mindbender; Deity reliably awakens.
units.basis: Assume each discard improves the next payout by another +2/+1. Next four payouts are 51,54,57,60 SP, sum 222 permanent SP banked on the off-board Deity. Standing-board sp_per_turn stays 0; 222 is the extra newly banked contribution realized when it joins this fight, not a second buff. Mindbender yields 4 discards x 6 others x 8 = 192 persistent board SP; effective marginal 222-192 = 30. Fresh Harbinger only banks 3+6+9+12=30, far worse than that alternative; long survival is the condition. Mixed marginal split: +222 in_fight SP realized on the Deity minus 192 permanent board SP from the alternative = 30 SP/turn at one fight per turn; the banked Deity contribution is not also counted as retained standing-board growth.
units.compare_to: Mindbender Ghur'sha T5 (current): four discards x six other minions x +4/+4 = 192 SP/turn. Cutthroat K'Thir T4: 32 board SP plus 32 banked Deity SP = 64 total.
units.premium: An improving payout can eventually beat a wide fixed buffer; it is a late ramp payoff, not an automatic upgrade when discovered.

units.name: Heroic Broodmother
units.text: Rally: Gain Divine Shield. Start of Combat: Attack immediately.
units.comps: Dragon shield carries; immediate Rally attack
units.setup: Two attacks before death; each newly gained shield absorbs one meaningful 40-damage hit; no Poet retention.
units.basis: Two Rally shield applications x 40 damage prevented = ~80 combat SP, excluding printed body and unpriced first-attack initiative. Bristleback Knight can also absorb roughly two hits via initial shield plus its refresh (~80). Marginal in_fight value is 80-80 = 0 SP/fight in this stated setup: zero reflects parity with the alternative, not exclusion of combat value. Immediate first-attack initiative is not separately quantified. A single attack gives only ~40, and extra attacks need survival.
units.compare_to: Bristleback Knight T5 (past): initial Divine Shield plus one surviving-damage refresh, about 80 combat SP at 40 damage per hit; Windfury helps trigger attacks.
units.premium: Guaranteed immediate first attack and shield generation on every attack rather than one refresh; strength depends on the carry's stats.

units.name: Hooktusk, Master Marauder
units.text: After you Discover a card, give your other Pirates +1/+1. (Improved by Golden minions you played this game!)
units.setup: Three Golden minions played previously; two Discovers/turn, 12 Gold spent, five other Pirates retained.
units.basis: Assume each Golden played improves +1/+1 to +4/+4 at three Goldens. Two Discovers x five other Pirates x 8 SP = 80/turn. Gunpowder Courier at 12 spend gives floor(12/5)=2 procs x six Pirates x 4 SP = 48; margin 32. Discovers must come from actual Discover effects/rewards, not merely receiving random cards.
units.compare_to: Gunpowder Courier T4 (current): about 48 SP/turn on six Pirates at two spending thresholds; easier triggers, no Golden-history ramp.
units.premium: Golden history increases the whole-board payout per Discover; at zero Goldens the same two Discovers give just 20 SP and lose to Courier.

units.name: Magicfin Mycologist
units.text: Once per turn, after you buy a Tavern spell, get a 1/1 Murloc and teach it that spell. (1 left!)
units.comps: Learned-spell Battlecry loops with Young Murk-Eye/Brann
units.setup: Buy a Misplaced Tea Set; its Apprentice is played once and Battlecry-retriggered twice by existing support; five recipients each cast.
units.basis: Learned spell becomes an Apprentice Battlecry: 3 casts x five targets x 8 SP = 120 recurring turn output, excluding the originally bought spell. Cataclysmic Harbinger supplies one extra Tea Set cast = 40; margin 80. One generated minion is ~3 gold-equivalent but its spell effect is already counted. Setup needs reliable retriggers; unsuited spells or no replay support sharply reduce value. Historical strength evidence: moved T5 to T6 on 2025-08-19, then its strategy ceiling was explicitly targeted on 2025-11-13 (Blizzard sources in valuation_notes).
units.compare_to: Cataclysmic Harbinger T5 (current): one extra copy of the same 40-SP Tea Set/turn. Magicfin itself was T5 before its August 2025 tier nerf.
units.premium: Turns a consumed spell into a repeatable Battlecry program, allowing permanent spell access plus existing trigger multipliers.

units.name: Nadina the Red
units.text: Deathrattle: Give 3 friendly Dragons Divine Shield.
units.comps: Large Dragon carries needing Divine Shield
units.setup: Deathrattle fires before three valuable unshielded Dragons die; each shield prevents a 40-damage hit.
units.basis: Three shields x ~40 avoided damage = 120 combat SP. Glowscale gives one shield worth ~40, so marginal in_fight value is 120-40 = 80 SP/fight, hence 80 SP/turn at one fight per turn. No permanent stat scaling is implied. Existing shields, bad death order, shield-breaking damage or too few Dragons reduce this.
units.compare_to: Glowscale T5 (current): one chosen Divine Shield/turn worth about 40 combat SP here; Vorkai Guardian T5 (past): two adjacent shields (~80), conditional on having none.
units.premium: Three late-fight shields in one slot, including reshielding Dragons that spent an earlier shield; a finisher rather than a recruit engine.

units.name: Ravaging Scorpid
units.text: After a friendly minion attacks, your Beetles have +4/+4 this game. Deathrattle: Summon a 2/2 Beetle.
units.setup: Six friendly attacks while Scorpid lives; four Beetles per fight; no starting-board Beetles retained into recruit.
units.basis: Six attacks add 6 x 8 = 48 permanent SP to the Beetle counter per round. With four Beetles, full later realization would add 192 SP of future combat output, versus Runed Progenitor's two +2/+2 upgrades at six deaths giving 32; that future-output difference of 160 is not the current-fight marginal. For this fight, retain the stated half-realization assumption for both: Scorpid gives 4 x 24 = 96 bonus SP plus its 2/2 Deathrattle body = 100; Progenitor gives 4 x 4 = 16 bonus SP plus its 2/2 Deathrattle body = 20. Marginal in_fight value is 100-20 = 80 SP/fight, hence 80 SP/turn. Existing accumulated Beetle stats are shared; no standing-board recruit gain is counted.
units.compare_to: Runed Progenitor T4 (past): six deaths produce two +2/+2 upgrades, +8 SP to every future Beetle, about +32 combat-output growth/round for four Beetles.
units.premium: Attacks grant twice the counter increase of an Avenge proc, and happen much more often than every third death.

units.name: Sanguine Champion
units.text: Battlecry and Deathrattle: Your Blood Gems give an extra +2/+1 this game.
units.comps: Quilboar gem-strength engine; Brann plus Young Murk-Eye
units.setup: Brann and Young Murk-Eye already present; one Murk-Eye retrigger and one ordinary death/round; spend 12 Blood Gems/round afterward.
units.basis: Each upgrade adds 3 SP per gem. Recurring Murk-Eye Battlecry doubled by Brann gives two upgrades, plus one death gives a third: 3 x 3 x 12 = 108 extra SP/turn after the pipeline matures. Initial play with Brann gives two separate setup upgrades: 2 x 3 x 12 = 72 first-use SP recorded once, excluded from the 108. Sanguine Refiner one Rally adds 3 x 12 = 36; margin 72. With two Refiner attacks the margin falls to 36. No intrinsic repeat Battlecry without support.
units.compare_to: Sanguine Refiner T5 (current): one Rally upgrade adds +1/+2, also 3 SP/gem, about 36 SP/turn across 12 gems; two attacks give 72. Pokey Thornmantle T5 (past): 24 on 12 gems per new +1/+1 upgrade.
units.premium: The individual upgrade is no larger than Refiner's; Battlecry plus Deathrattle makes it accessible to multiple existing retrigger engines.

units.name: Silent Deliverer
units.text: Battlecry: Get a random Golden minion from Tier 4. It doesn’t give a Triple Reward.
units.comps: Any (golden Tier 4 tempo or engine lottery); Pirate cycling
units.setup: Play once without Brann; keep a random golden Tier 4 in place of an empty/temporary slot, average printed 18 SP.
units.basis: One golden Tier 4 is roughly 2 x Tier-4 median 9 = 18 printed SP once; no Triple Reward. A displaced real body reduces the net stat gain; useful text can be worth much more. The extra card is ~3 gold-equivalent once, not gold/turn. This card itself is not an ongoing engine; marginal/turn is zero.
units.compare_to: Elite Navigator T5 (current): goldens a chosen existing Tier-4-or-lower Pirate, about +9 printed SP once at the Tier-4 median, and upgrades its engine text; Imposing Percussionist T4 discovers one normal Demon (~3 gold-equivalent once).
units.premium: A free golden engine/body rather than a normal card, at the price of random fit and no triple discover.

units.name: Sky Admiral Rogers
units.text: After you spend 9 Gold, get a random Bounty. (9 Gold left!)
units.comps: Pirate Bounty cycling; any high-spend economy
units.setup: Spend 18 Gold/turn using sales and economy; all five Bounties equally likely; compare one Bigwig Rally.
units.basis: 18/9 = 2 Bounties. Four 2-cost outcomes plus Friendly Bounty's ~3-gold card average (2+2+2+2+3)/5 = 2.2 gold-equivalent each: 4.4/turn. Bigwig one attack gives 2.2; extra 2.2 x 3.5 SP/gold = 7.7 marginal opportunity SP. Do not add Bounty buff stats again. Two Bigwig attacks erase this premium; spending 27+ extends Rogers without needing combat survival.
units.compare_to: Bigwig Bandit T4 (current): one Rally yields one Bounty, ~2.2 gold-equivalent or 7.7 opportunity SP/turn in this model; two attacks match Rogers at 18 spend.
units.premium: Recruit-phase spend thresholds can repeatedly feed the same turn's purchases; no dependency on winning a combat attack.

units.name: Snazzy Phantom
units.text: After a friendly minion is Reborn, give stats equal to its Attack to your right-most Undead.
units.setup: Four friendly Reborn events, each returning Undead has 30 Attack including aura; right-most Undead survives all buffs.
units.basis: Interpret stats equal to Attack as +30/+30 per event: 4 x 60 = 240 temporary SP. Barrier Banshee gets 4 x 16 = 64 temporary SP plus perhaps two effective shield refreshes x 40 = 80: ~144. Marginal in_fight value is 240-144 = 96 SP/fight, hence 96 SP/turn at one fight per turn. Buffs are not marked permanent. Reborn does not retain arbitrary old buffs; 30 Attack must come from printed/global effects.
units.compare_to: Barrier Banshee T5 (current): four Reborn events give +32/+32 = 64 SP plus estimated 80 shield value, ~144 combat SP.
units.premium: Converts an already-large Undead attack aura into Attack and Health on another carry, rather than a fixed +8/+8.

units.name: The Shadow of Doubt
units.text: Whenever a card is added to your hand, give your Deity +4/+5.
units.setup: Ten cards added to hand/turn, 30 Tavern spells previously cast, only one discard/turn; Deity awakens.
units.basis: 10 additions x (+4/+5) = 90 permanent SP banked on Deity each round. No standing-board recruit stats; sp_in_fight reports only the newly banked 90 when the Deity appears. Faceless Converter at 30 spells is assumed +32/+31 = 63 SP once per death/round; effective marginal 90-63 = 27. Mindbender with this setup's one discard gives six others x 8 = 48, so is also below 90. Awakening failure can make all Deity-only investment worthless in that fight; no extra C'Thun redistribution counted. Marginal basis is in_fight: 90-63 = 27 SP realized per fight from the newly banked Deity contribution, with one fight per turn; no standing-board growth is added.
units.compare_to: Faceless Converter T5 (current): assuming +1/+1 improvement per prior Tavern spell, one death at 30 spells banks +32/+31 = 63 Deity SP/round. Mindbender Ghur'sha T5: ~48 board SP with one discard.
units.premium: Uses every card entering hand, so purchases, generated cards and spell production all feed one persistent carry.

units.name: Torrential Ruiner
units.text: Whenever you cast a spell on a Naga, give your minions +2/+3.
units.setup: Four recruit-phase spells target a Naga; seven minions remain on board for each trigger.
units.basis: Four casts x seven minions x (+2/+3 = 5 SP) = 140 permanent SP/turn, excluding the spells' own effects. Critter Wrangler gives four targets x +2/+2 = 16; margin 124. Temporary Spellcraft duration does not make this separate recruit-triggered stat buff temporary. Losing one board slot lowers output by 20.
units.compare_to: Critter Wrangler T4 (past): four targeted spells x +2/+2 to that target = 16 SP/turn on the same board. Shamanic Tidecaller T5 is the parallel Murloc-wide targeted-spell engine.
units.premium: One qualifying spell buffs the whole warband, rather than just its recipient; an uncapped trigger count makes the ceiling.

units.name: Turbo Hogrider
units.text: After you play a Choose One card, this plays 2 Blood Gems on all your Quilboar.
units.setup: Play three Choose One cards, spend 12 Gold/turn; six Quilboar including Turbo retained; each Blood Gem worth 6 SP.
units.basis: 3 Choose One plays x 2 gems x 6 Quilboar x 6 SP = 216 permanent SP/turn. Darkgaze Elder at 12 spend averages 12/8=1.5 thresholds across turns: 1.5 x 2 x 6 x 6 = 108; margin 108. Three Choose One cards must be supplied by real generators/shops; no free acquisition assumed. At just one Choose One play, Turbo produces 72 and can lose to Elder.
units.compare_to: Darkgaze Elder T5 (past): same two-gems-to-all-Quilboar packet per 8 Gold spent, averaging 108 SP/turn at 12 spend, six Quilboar and 6-SP gems.
units.premium: The reward is identical to the older Tier 5; a supported Choose One stream can trigger it much more often.

units.name: Twisted Wrathguard
units.text: After you sell a minion, add a Fodder to your next Refresh.
units.setup: Sell six minions/turn in a funded cycling setup; consume all six added Fodders after refreshing; each has 30 SP after shop buffs.
units.basis: Six sales x one Fodder x assumed 30 absorbed SP = 180 permanent SP/turn. Past Woodland Defiler adds one Fodder to each of three refreshes: 3 x 30 = 90, hence margin 90. Fodder is automatically consumed on appearing (Blizzard Season 13 source in valuation_notes), not a 3-gold minion that must be purchased. Uses realized 30 SP, not an unverified token base. At only three sales it merely matches Defiler.
units.compare_to: Woodland Defiler T4 (past): three Fodders across the next three refreshes = 90 SP/turn at the same absorbed size.
units.premium: An uncapped sell-to-meal conversion in place of three scheduled meals; shop strength and sales both increase the ceiling.

units.name: Tyrael
units.text: Activate (1): Set another minion's stats to 50/50.
units.comps: Any (fresh utility units made combat-sized); low-stat carry conversion
units.setup: Each round there is a fresh useful 5/5 minion below 50/50; activate once for 1 Gold.
units.basis: A 5/5 becomes 50/50: 100-10 = 90 permanent SP/turn when fresh targets exist. Activation costs 1 Gold, about 3.5 opportunity SP, so net 86.5. Sewer Escapee adds 14 SP for the same 1 Gold, net 10.5; stat-only margin 76, before pricing its Bonus Keyword. Once targets already exceed 50/50 this is not scaling and can reduce stats; never count the entire 100 as new stats.
units.compare_to: Sewer Escapee T5 (current): +7/+7 and one Bonus Keyword for 1 Gold, 14 raw SP/turn before valuing the keyword. Holy Vanguard T4 at low hero Health supplies a conditional 40/40 shielded body instead of upgrading another unit.
units.premium: Compresses late-game catch-up into one click while preserving a target's useful text; its fixed ceiling makes it a tempo bridge.

units.name: Ultraviolet Ascendant
units.text: Start of Combat: Give your other Elementals +3/+3. (Improves after you play an Elemental!)
units.comps: Elemental cycling into a wide combat buff
units.setup: Twenty Elementals played while its improving text is active; five other Elementals; assume each play improves +1/+1.
units.basis: Start-of-Combat buff is assumed +(3+20)/+(3+20): five recipients x 46 = 230 temporary SP. Showy Cyclist at 30 prior spells is assumed +12/+11 to five Naga = 115 combat SP. Marginal in_fight value is 230-115 = 115 SP/fight, hence 115 SP/turn at one fight per turn. Three more Elemental plays would increase later fights by another 30 SP of combat output; that future growth is not added to this fight's 115 marginal value.
units.compare_to: Showy Cyclist T5 (current): at 30 spells and +1/+1 improvement per three, Deathrattle gives +12/+11 to five Naga = about 115 combat SP; similarly spell-history-powered and temporary.
units.premium: A guaranteed start-of-fight wide buff that increases with elemental cycling; cannot be treated as permanent recruit growth.

units.name: Unbound Tempest
units.text: After you play 4 Elementals, gain the stats of the highest- Health minion in the Tavern. (4 left!)
units.setup: Play eight Elementals/turn; highest-Health Tavern minion is about 30/30 at both triggers; no benefit assumed from consuming it.
units.basis: 8/4 = 2 copies of a 60-SP shop minion = 120 permanent SP/turn. Flaming Enforcer consumes one similar 60-SP body at end of turn, so margin 60. At four plays they match 60; an unbuffed 12-SP shop gives only 24 here. Copying stats does not generate a buyable hand card or gold.
units.compare_to: Flaming Enforcer T4 (current): one 30/30 highest-Health shop meal/turn = 60 SP. Living Prison T4 can copy the next purchased minion for 1 Gold.
units.premium: Multiple transfers of the best shop stats without waiting for end of turn, with no gold activation fee.

units.name: Utility Drone
units.text: At the end of your turn, give your minions +4/+5 for each Magnetization they have.
units.setup: Ten Magnetizations across retained minions; four targeted spells on Mechs per recruit; no Drakkari.
units.basis: Ten existing Magnetizations x (+4/+5 = 9 SP) = 90 permanent SP/turn. Count attachments, not just the number of Mechs; two stacks on one Mech yield 18. Glambot on four targeted spells adds four 4/4 Satellites = 32 SP; margin 58 before secondary Satellite synergies. Ten stacks are setup, not ten new attachments required every turn.
units.compare_to: Glambot T4 (current): four spells targeting Mechs produce 4 x 8 = 32 SP/turn in 4/4 attachments. Drone pays repeatedly on the entire existing attachment stock.
units.premium: Turns accumulated Magnetic history into repeat wide scaling; each future attachment also increases every later end-of-turn payout.

units.name: Veteran Brigand
units.text: Choose One - This plays 3 Blood Gems on all your minions; or cast Blood Gem Barrage 3 times.
units.comps: Quilboar gems; Choose One; shop Blood Gem Barrage
units.setup: Choose immediate gems; seven minions including Brigand; gems give +3/+3 (6 SP).
units.basis: 3 gems x 7 minions x 6 SP = 126 permanent SP once; exclude the printed body. Gem Smuggler gives 2 x 6 other minions x 6 = 72 once, so Brigand is +54 SP per play, not per turn. Alternative mode casts Blood Gem Barrage three times: that spell improves future refreshed shops by +2/+2 worth of gems each cast; it does not immediately gem the board, and its delayed realized value is not added to 126.
units.compare_to: Gem Smuggler T5 (past): two gems on six other minions = 72 SP once with the same 6-SP gems; Razorfen Flapper T4 supplies a single Blood Gem Barrage per Battlecry/Deathrattle.
units.premium: Twenty-one immediate gem placements versus twelve, or three permanent shop-scaling spell casts; Choose One also feeds Turbo.

units.name: Victorious Geomant
units.text: Activate (2): Get 6 Blood Gems. Cast any that don't fit on your left-most minion.
units.comps: Quilboar hand-gem engines; Blood Gem multipliers
units.setup: Activate once for 2 Gold; six gems each worth 6 SP are cast; hand has room unless noted.
units.basis: 6 x 6 = 36 permanent SP supplied/turn; subtract 2 Gold x 3.5 = 7 opportunity SP for net 29. Bongo Bopper supplies four gems (two hand plus two self-cast), 4 x 6 = 24 for no activation fee: marginal 29-24 = 5. Overflow automatically casts on the left-most minion; those casts need not receive hand-play-only multipliers. At base 2-SP gems the net is only 5 versus Bongo's 8, marginal -3. Mixed marginal split: +12 permanent SP/turn (36-24), minus 7 economy SP/turn from the extra 2 Gold fee, total 5.
units.compare_to: Bongo Bopper T5 (past): two hand gems plus two played on itself each end turn, 24 SP/turn with 6-SP gems and no gold fee.
units.premium: Six immediately available, mostly targetable gems instead of four partly self-locked ones; a reliable resource source rather than a standalone capstone.

units.name: Young Murk-Eye
units.text: At the end of your turn, trigger the Battlecries of adjacent minions.
units.comps: Battlecry scaling: Quilboar, Murloc, economy, menagerie
units.setup: Adjacent Sanguine Champion and Hackerfin; Brann present; 12 gems used next round; Hackerfin has no extra Bonus Keyword improvement priced.
units.basis: Champion retrigger with Brann gives 2 x 3 x 12 = 72 future permanent SP; Hackerfin gives two x six other minions x 5 = 60 immediate permanent SP. Total 132/turn, excluding both minions' initial Battlecries and any ordinary Champion death. Kelp Keeper triggers only the better Battlecry, 72 SP with Brann, for 1 Gold: 72-3.5=68.5 net; marginal 132-68.5=63.5. Stronger keyword improvements and Drakkari can increase this, but are excluded. Mixed marginal split: +60 permanent SP/turn (132-72), plus 3.5 economy SP/turn saved by avoiding the alternative's 1 Gold fee, total 63.5.
units.compare_to: Kelp Keeper T4 (current): one selected adjacent-independent Battlecry for 1 Gold; same Brann and Champion give 72 raw or 68.5 net opportunity SP/turn. Rylak Metalhead T4 (past) supplies a combat-gated adjacent retrigger.
units.premium: Two adjacent Battlecry programs each end turn, no activation fee, and compatibility with both Brann and Drakkari.

units.name: Cobalt Guardian
units.text: Whenever you summon a Mech, gain Divine Shield.
units.setup: Buffed Guardian; a shield at combat start and two in-fight Mech summons restore it; enemy hits average 12 Attack.
units.basis: Landmark: the original repeatable-shield Mech carry, later replaced by Deflect-o-Bot. Three shields ×12 damage avoided =36 combat SP; a single-shield carrier prevents ~12, so +24 per fight. Resets that happen while already shielded do not count; judgement based on era play.
units.compare_to: Shielded Minibot T2: ~12 combat SP from one shield on the same buffed body.
units.premium: Repeated shields rather than one shield; attack buffs get several more trades.

units.name: Floating Watcher
units.text: Whenever your hero takes damage on your turn, gain +2/+2.
units.setup: Three Demons played each turn with Wrath Weaver dealing hero damage; no immunity yet.
units.basis: Landmark: the early health-spending Demon snowball; moved T3→T4 in February 2020. Three self-damage events ×(+2/+2)=12 permanent SP. Another era Wrath Weaver also gives ~12, so raw growth premium is ~0; Watcher supplies another carry and also accepts other self-damage sources.
units.compare_to: Wrath Weaver T1, 2020 +2/+2 version: 3 Demon plays ×4=12 SP/turn.
units.premium: Adds a second scaling body and converts non-Demon hero damage too; tier does not guarantee more raw growth.

units.name: Soul Juggler
units.text: After a friendly Demon dies, deal 4 damage to the highest-Health enemy minion.
units.setup: Seven friendly Demon deaths while Juggler survives; several small tokens; shield targets present.
units.basis: Landmark: defined the low-investment Demon damage composition and punished Divine Shields. Seven deaths ×3 damage=21 damage-SP proxy; token/aura alternative supplies ~8, leaving ~13. Random shots, overkill and popping shields make this an exchange estimate, not literal permanent stats; era-play judgement.
units.compare_to: Siegebreaker T4, era +1 Attack aura: roughly 8 useful Attack across the same Demon bodies.
units.premium: Converts each expendable Demon into independent damage instead of requiring it to trade.
units.era_text: After a friendly Demon dies, deal 3 damage to a random enemy minion.
units.version_note: Uses the 2020 random 3-damage effect, not the CSV late 4-damage targeting rework.

units.name: Leapfrogger
units.text: Deathrattle: Give a friendly Beast +1/+1 and this Deathrattle.
units.era: Era D, autumn 2021 after launch nerf
units.comps: Leapfrogger Beasts with Baron and reborn
units.setup: Protected Baron, reborn Frog and Beast tokens; assume 16 successful +1/+1 transfers including repeated inherited Deathrattles.

Sixteen effective transfers ×2=32 combat SP, versus doubled Spawn buffs ~24, so +8; many fully assembled fights exceed this sharply. This is a conservative illustrative chain, not an expectation over combat orders.

units.name: Khadgar
units.text: Your cards that summon minions summon twice as many.

units.setup: Two token Battlecries played and their extra tokens sold; board space available; no Brann assumed.

units.valuation_limit: The illustrative number is a baseline for the stated setup, not a finite ceiling on keyword, recursion or selection value.

units.name: Cave Hydra
units.text: Also damages the minions next to whomever this attacks.
units.setup: Hydra buffed to20 Attack by other cards; two useful side-target hits per fight in total; no summon buffer assumed.

Two side hits×20=40 damage-SP beyond ordinary attacks; a replacement Highmane adds two2/2 bodies=8 SP, leaving32. Held buffs on the main bodies are baseline on both sides; shields, positioning and overkill can erase the cleave premium. Era-play judgement.

units.name: Cobalt Scalebane
units.text: At the end of your turn, give another random friendly minion +3 Attack.
units.setup: One retained target each end of turn; no multiplier; buff is not wasted on a card sold next turn.

units.compare_to: Micro Machine T1: +1 Attack=1 SP/turn; Iron Sensei T3 with another Mech:4 SP/turn.
units.premium: Flexible tribal targeting and a solid body, rather than an endgame rate of growth.

units.name: Drakonid Enforcer
units.text: After a friendly minion loses Divine Shield, gain +2/+2.
units.comps: Divine Shield Dragons and mixed shields
units.setup: Five friendly shields break while Enforcer survives.

units.compare_to: Bronze Warden, era T3: shield prevents about 8 damage; reborn body is additional tempo not priced here.

units.name: Annihilan Battlemaster
units.text: Battlecry: Gain +2 Health for each Health your hero is missing.
units.setup: Hero missing 25 Health; single Battlecry, no Brann; original +1 Health version.

Missing 25 Health ×1=25 one-off Health; a hand-based Twilight Drake might gain ~5, so ~20 incremental SP on purchase. Its low Attack needed support; later CSV doubled the Health coefficient and lowered the tier.

units.era_text: Battlecry: Gain +1 Health for each Health your hero is missing.
units.version_note: Values the launch-era T5 effect; CSV has later T4 +2 Health.

units.name: Mama Bear
units.text: Whenever you summon a Beast, give it +6/+6.
units.setup: T6 Mama +5/+5; two retained Beast plays per recruit phase and four new Beast summons in combat.

Recruit: two retained Beast plays×(+5/+5)=20 permanent SP/turn; combat: four new summons×10=40 temporary SP. Original Pack Leader gives2×3=6 permanent recruit Attack and4×3=12 combat Attack, so growth premium14 and separate combat premium28.

units.era_text: Whenever you summon a Beast, give it +5/+5.

units.name: Lil' Rag
units.text: After you play an Elemental, give a friendly minion stats equal to the Elemental's Tier.

units.name: Majordomo Executus

units.name: Menagerie Magician
units.text: Battlecry: Give a random friendly Beast, Dragon, and Murloc +2/+2.

units.name: Defender of Argus

Two targets ×(+1/+1)=4 permanent SP; era Sparring Partner gives Taunt but no stats, so at least +4 stat premium, or ~2 versus a small normal buff purchase. Chosen matched fallback is Rockpool Hunter (~2); Taunt control is valuable but not converted into invented SP.

units.name: Strongshell Scavenger

units.name: Dynamic Duo

Post-20.2.2 Bristleback Brute adds a +2/+2 first-gem bonus=4 effect SP, so premium8; the original six gems are baseline and are not counted again.

units.name: Baron Rivendare

units.name: Cap'n Hoggarr

Golden+normal Hoggarr can refund3 per purchase and fund long loops, but that assembled ceiling is not the normal-copy estimate; economy-engines.md §4.3.

Immunity permits future Weaver growth when health would otherwise run out; do not charge all existing Weaver growth to Mal'Ganis or price saved hero health as board stats.

1.typical: Typical marginal ~0–4 SP/turn versus the stated alternative (often combat-equivalent), with ~0–4 permanent SP once; most unbuffed combat additions are 2–5 SP/fight. Weaver can gross 8 durable SP/turn, while Prisonguard grosses 6 but costs 1 gold. These are central design guesses, not a percentile fit.

strong_units.why: A real early engine: 8 gross permanent SP/turn at two Demon plays; 4 over Rewinder in the later shared window, ~7 over Lullabot before Tier 2.

2.typical: Typical marginal ~0–8 SP/turn with ~0–10 permanent SP once; one-shot economy usually ~0–1.5 gold-equivalent/turn after amortization. Setup-heavy exceptions include Tarecgosa ~9 permanent, Eternal Knight ~18 permanent, early Aviator ~15 combat and Tusker ~11 combat marginal; Assistant ~18 SP once is conditional on meal size.

Upper examples are Hooktail ~17 permanent, Mindslasher ~16 mixed and Wolf Pup ~23 in-fight marginal; Fetid Corroder can supply ~28 SP once via discard. Wolf Pup also supplies ~25 retained SP/turn through a separate Fishbait recruit attack, excluded from its combat marginal. Zero and negative substitutions are possible; combat/economy values are not durable growth.

Combat multipliers/conditional tempo can add30-90+ combat SP; weak sustained-growth comparisons can be negative (Maritime Extortionist -17). Combat value is not interchangeable with permanent growth.

owner_picture.evidence: Many units fit the strong composition player/enabler picture: Gearfin supplies two cheap spells, Air Baller gives24 one-off stats to six allies, and Kelp Keeper repeats an existing Battlecry rather than supplying the engine payoff itself. Soulkeeping Jailer (~89 marginal permanent SP/turn here), Hot-Air Surveyor and Persistent Poet break the little-bit-of-stats ceiling by providing broad consumption, resource multiplication or permanent combat retention; Banana Slamma adds a separate ~72 marginal combat Attack. Conversely, Refreshing Anomaly and Snare Trapper offer little direct numeric premium over lower-tier economy, so tier4 is a mixed collection of enabling thresholds rather than a uniform stat budget.

methodology.scope: Exactly the62 units in in/W2.csv, normal versions only; printed text copied verbatim. The supplied current-pool snapshot is authoritative for batch membership, not an independently verified live-November pool; local notes warn Naga flags may persist after rotation.
methodology.stage: T in window means game turn, not Tavern Tier. Good setup means functional midgame synergy, generally turns8-9, not an unlimited gold loop or a finished tier6 board.
methodology.units: SP=Attack+Health. Printed bodies are excluded from growth fields except explicit Magnetic transfers and summoned combat bodies. Historical counter bonuses are described separately from fresh growth.
methodology.marginal: Marginal uses the named usual available alternative in each basis, with common resource generation/buffs held fixed. Those alternatives are practical estimates, not an optimized mathematical best across all legal boards. High tier4 alternatives are allowed for this counterfactual; compare_to also supplies a lower-tier or historical analogue.
methodology.permanence: Recruit buffs persist; combat buffs expire unless a retention effect says otherwise. Permanent hand/Deity SP is included only when a reliable hand-summoner/awakening makes it combat-realizable; local fields identify the dependence. A combat global aura can raise subsequent standing-board stats even when its trigger occurred during combat.
methodology.combat_marginal: For pure combat/tech units, marginal_sp_per_turn is incremental useful combat SP per one fight/round, not permanent growth. Read value_kind and basis alongside that number. Damage and shield approximations are rough combat equivalents with overkill/survival assumptions.
methodology.overlap: Some sp_in_fight values show combat realization of the same persistent aura reported in sp_per_turn; the basis flags overlap. Do not blindly sum all fields, especially for Plaguerunner or for free cards whose eventual stats were described.
methodology.economy: 1 useful generated minion roughly3 card-equivalent gold, a refresh1, and known Tavern spells use printed cost. Liquid sale-only value may be much smaller. Marginal economy converts at3.5 SP/gold. For purchased buy/sell cycles gold_per_turn is net after the2-gold cycle cost; held generators are gross generated value. A basis explicitly identifies gross refresh/spell face value when that is the useful measure. Card stats and face-value gold are alternative views, not additive.
methodology.one_off: sp_one_off is per purchased copy; any per-turn marginal from cycling or amortization states its cadence/horizon. It is not a claim that a held Battlecry/sale minion triggers again automatically.
methodology.unknowns: Baller upgrade increments, Lovesick/Parasitic improvement increments, exact random-card mixes, Fishbait rewards and Wrathguard Activate improvement are not fully specified. Baller upgrades/Fishbait rewards/Activate improvement excluded; other assumed increments are explicit and low confidence.
methodology.sources: Read-only local evidence: in/W2.csv; docs/research/battlegrounds/keywords.md, rules.md, power-analysis.md sections1-2, economy-engines.md and strategy-eras.md relevant excerpts, patch-history.md relevant excerpts, plus data/minions.json and data/spells.json. Combat attack counts, practical alternatives, retained-board assumptions and all marginal estimates are play-informed judgement, not measured win rates.

5.typical: A working non-tech engine or good tempo piece often adds roughly5–60 marginal SP-equivalent per round over its stated fallback; mature wide or combat engines can reach80–140+, while several generators and narrow carries are near0 or negative. Direct one-off permanent buffs are usually0–40 SP, with a keyword-supported Hackerfin example around54; a zero includes units whose reward is a card or combat-only effect. valuation_conventions: All figures value the normal, non-golden CSV versions; T in window means game turn, not Tavern Tier. These are rough scenario judgments, not observed win-rate or current-meta rankings; strength describes fit to a working composition.

SP is Attack+Health summed across owned retained board bodies. sp_per_turn is permanent growth per round reaching that board, including explicitly permanent combat gains or next-recruit realization; sp_one_off covers direct initial permanent buffs. Existing printed bodies and upgrades to held cards are excluded unless actually deployed. sp_in_fight is additional temporary bodies, buffs, useful damage or shield-hit equivalents, not also the permanent portion.

marginal_sp_per_turn is a PER-ROUND EQUIVALENT: permanent growth plus temporary combat value realized once that round, plus distinct economy at3.5 SP/g, less the stated alternative’s round value and unique activation/resource cost. One-off differences are spread over a stated three-round hold. Combat-only numbers therefore are not a forecast of permanent recruit growth. This common comparison is a convenience, not a claim that temporary and durable SP have equal long-term value.

The best usual alternative is the plausible replacement at this stage and in the stated scenario, not an unlimited-access Tier6 or perfect golden board. Where the closest analogy differs, compare_to states both the historical/lower-tier anchor and the actual fallback. Availability, timing, slot consolidation and targeting quality are unpriced unless explicitly estimated.

Gold-equivalent is gross useful free material: a generated minion≈3g, a spell≈its printed cost. A sell-immediately minion is only1 realized gold; no generated golden is assumed to give a Triple Reward. If a generated card is already counted as its realized stats, gold_per_turn is diagnostic and is NOT also converted in the marginal arithmetic. Alternative generator costs cancel when shared.

A growing global spell or shop bonus is valued only when useful stat packets or acquired/consumed bodies realize it. Some entries explicitly use two banked upgrades as a representative mature rate; others isolate the newest increment, as stated. Full offered shops, wasted targets, old accumulated stats and support engines’ original output are not counted as new output.

Persistent Deity/Beetle counters and improved future-combat coefficients are distinguished from permanent standing-board stats: they are scored as realized in-fight value. C’Thun redistribution is counted only for Converter’s explicitly stated C’Thun scenario; Sapper and Cutthroat comparisons instead assume Y’Shaarj.

Shield estimates use one useful enemy hit avoided; poison/destruction use useful enemy Health removed without also counting its Attack. Both are matchup-dependent proxies. Additive damage is discounted for overkill/blocked hits, and only surviving/space-valid recipients are assumed.

Conditional good setups can be much stronger than the first purchase. Helpers, spell supply, shop capture, hand space, survival and relevant unit counts are explicit assumptions. Shared support is held constant for the slot comparison; no maximum-trigger or infinite-loop valuation is intended.

Unspecified improvement increments, random distributions, Lockbox cadence and expected keyword utility are labeled low confidence. No claim of competitive strength or balance nerf is inferred merely from first_seen_date; was_overtuned is unused because this batch does not establish a relevant nerf/removal judgment.

Blood Gems played in combat are temporary unless explicitly retained: Vineweaver expressly makes them permanent; Bonker does not in the comparison text. A negative one-round marginal for Vineweaver therefore does not imply lower multi-round durable growth.
